title: HR & Recruitment Coordinator
description:
# HR & Recruitment Assistant



**Excellent Spoken English Required | Remote | Long-Term**



TSG Behavioral Health & Community Services is looking for a reliable **HR & Recruitment Assistant** to help with interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and employee follow-up.



This position requires **very strong spoken and written English**. You will speak directly with U.S.-based job applicants, so you must be confident, professional, easy to understand, and comfortable leading conversations.



## Responsibilities



* Review resumes and applications

* Screen job applicants

* Conduct initial phone and video interviews

* Ask follow-up questions and identify potential concerns

* Document interview notes

* Recommend which applicants should move forward

* Schedule interviews

* Follow up with applicants

* Assist with job postings and recruiting

* Prepare onboarding documents

* Collect required employee paperwork

* Track new-hire onboarding

* Follow up with new employees

* Maintain organized HR and hiring records

* Assist leadership with general HR tasks



## Requirements



* **Excellent spoken English**

* Strong written English

* Confident speaking with U.S.-based applicants

* Professional and friendly communication style

* Strong listening skills

* Organized and dependable

* Comfortable conducting interviews

* Able to work independently

* Good judgment and attention to detail



Previous HR, recruitment, interviewing, customer service, call center, or administrative experience is preferred.



Experience working with a U.S. company is a plus.



## Schedule



Approximately **30 hours per week**



Must be available during **U.S. Eastern Time business hours**.



## Pay



**Starting Pay: $3.50 USD/hour**



This is a long-term position with the opportunity for increased responsibilities based on performance.



## How to Apply



Start your application with:



**TSG HR**



Please include:



1. Your resume

2. Your HR, recruiting, interviewing, or customer service experience

3. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time

4. A **1–2 minute video introduction in English**



In your video, briefly answer:



* Tell us about yourself.

* What experience do you have interviewing or speaking with customers, applicants, or employees?

* Why would you be good at interviewing job applicants?



**Do not read directly from a script. We want to hear your natural English and communication style.**



Applicants selected to move forward will complete a short live interview and may be asked to conduct a **mock interview**.

title: Virtual Medical Care Coordinator / Medical Assistant Support
description:
Starting Pay:** $3.00 USD/hour

Pay After Successful 90-Day Review:** $3.50 USD/hour



TSG Health & Wellness is seeking a reliable and highly organized Virtual Medical Care Coordinator to support our providers and patients throughout the healthcare process.



This position is ideal for someone with previous healthcare, medical office, medical virtual assistant, or patient coordination experience who understands medical terminology and can communicate confidently with patients in English.



Key Responsibilities



* Schedule and confirm patient medical appointments

* Complete patient intake and preliminary administrative screening

* Send appointment reminders and follow up with patients who are unresponsive

* Make sure required intake forms and medical documents are completed

* Coordinate lab orders, referrals, and follow-up appointments as directed by the provider

* Follow up with patients after appointments and assist with after-care coordination

* Track outstanding labs, referrals, paperwork, and provider requests

* Help patients address pharmacy or medication-access issues and escalate clinical concerns to the provider

* Assist the Physician Assistant and other providers with administrative and patient-care coordination requests

* Coordinate care between medical and mental health services when needed

* Schedule provider meetings and request medical records or other documentation

* Track patient care-plan follow-up and make sure important next steps are not missed

* Maintain accurate, confidential, and HIPAA-conscious documentation



Requirements



* **Excellent spoken and written English is required**

* Comfortable speaking with U.S. patients by phone

* Familiarity with medical terminology and the U.S. healthcare process

* Previous experience in healthcare, medical administration, medical VA work, patient coordination, nursing support, or a related field preferred

* Strong follow-up and organizational skills

* Able to handle multiple patients and deadlines without losing track of tasks

* Professional, compassionate, and comfortable dealing with patients who may need repeated follow-up

* Familiarity with EHR/EMR systems is a plus



What We Are Looking For



We need someone who does more than schedule appointments. You should be able to follow a patient through the care process**, identify outstanding tasks, make sure referrals and labs are completed, follow up when patients become unresponsive, and keep the provider informed of anything requiring clinical attention.



**Important:** This is a patient-care coordination and provider-support position. The employee does not independently diagnose, prescribe, provide medical advice, or make clinical treatment decisions.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about your healthcare experience

2. Your experience communicating with U.S. patients

3. Any EHR/EMR systems you have used

4. A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit for this role

5. Your current availability and internet/work-from-home setup

6. Do you have any other work obligations ?

title: Experienced MCA Cold Caller / App Getter – Business Funding | Base + Commission
description:
PillarStar Capital is a growing U.S. business-funding company looking for an experienced MCA Cold Caller / App Getter to join our team.



This is not an entry-level cold-calling position.



We are specifically looking for someone who already understands Merchant Cash Advance (MCA), alternative business funding, and how to speak confidently with U.S. business owners.



Your primary goal is to turn leads into qualified merchants with completed applications and bank statements.



You will work leads provided by PillarStar and move merchants through:



Lead → Conversation → Interest → Qualification → Application/Bank Statements → Complete Package



Our processing and closing team will handle the later stages of the transaction.



What You Will Do

Make outbound calls to U.S. business owners.

Speak with owners and decision makers.

Identify current or future business-funding needs.

Determine requested funding amount and use of funds.

Ask about monthly business revenue.

Identify existing MCA positions and payments.

Qualify merchants according to PillarStar guidelines.

Request applications and recent business bank statements.

Handle common merchant objections professionally.

Follow up aggressively but professionally with interested merchants.

Re-engage previous leads.

Maintain accurate CRM notes and follow-up dates.

Work closely with processing and closing staff.

Help consistently generate complete funding packages, not just calls.

Who We Are Looking For



2+ years of direct MCA/business-funding experience is strongly preferred.



You should already understand terms such as:



First position

Second position

Stacking

Daily/weekly payments

Bank statements

Revenue qualification

Funding applications



You should also have:



Strong spoken English.

Clear, confident phone presence.

Experience calling U.S. business owners.

Strong objection-handling skills.

Experience asking merchants for applications and bank statements.

CRM and outbound-dialer experience.

Strong follow-up discipline.

Reliable computer and high-speed internet.

Backup internet/power.

Availability during U.S. Eastern business hours.

Compensation



Starting rate: $4.00/hour



Strong candidates with verifiable MCA experience may start higher, up to $5.00/hour.



There will be a 30-day performance review, with opportunities for increases based on results.



You will also earn:



5% of PillarStar Capital's commission actually collected on funded transactions originating from your assigned leads.



Commission is earned only after the transaction funds and PillarStar receives its commission.



As the company grows, strong performers will have opportunities for increased compensation, bonuses, senior sales responsibilities, and advancement into closing roles.



How Performance Is Measured



We care about results, not meaningless dialing.



We measure:



Calls → Merchant Conversations → Interested Merchants → Applications/Statements Requested → Complete Packages → Funded Deals



We also measure call quality, attendance, follow-up, CRM accuracy, professionalism, and package quality.



HOW TO APPLY



Use this subject line:



PILLARSTAR MCA – [Your Name] – [Years of MCA Experience]



Please submit:



1. Your resume



2. A REQUIRED 60–90 second voice sample



In your normal speaking voice:



Introduce yourself.

Tell us how many years of MCA/business-funding experience you have.

Give us a 20–30 second example of how you would open a call with a U.S. business owner.

Then answer this merchant objection:



“I'm not sending you my bank statements until you tell me what rate you're offering.”



Do not submit an AI-generated voice.



Answer These 7 Questions

How many years have you worked specifically in MCA or alternative business funding? What were your roles?

In your most recent MCA role, approximately how many complete applications + bank-statement packages did you personally generate per week?

Approximately how many funded transactions per month originated from your opportunities, if your company tracked this?

Explain the difference between a first-position MCA, second-position MCA, and stacking.

Write exactly what you would say if a merchant tells you:

“I'm not sending statements until you tell me the rate.”

Which MCA CRMs, dialers, or sales platforms have you previously used?

What hourly rate are you currently seeking, and are you available Monday–Friday during U.S. Eastern business hours?



Qualified candidates will be invited to a short interview and live MCA merchant role-play.

title: Compliance Coordinator
description:
TSGBH is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Compliance Coordinator to support our behavioral health operations.



This position will help ensure that required documentation, employee files, client records, credentialing information, training requirements, and internal compliance processes are completed accurately and on time.



This is not simply an administrative assistant position. We need someone who can review records, identify missing or expired items, follow up with staff, maintain compliance trackers, and escalate concerns before they become larger problems.



Key Responsibilities



* Review employee and contractor files for required documentation

* Monitor expiration dates for licenses, credentials, certifications, trainings, and other required documents

* Maintain compliance tracking spreadsheets and internal systems

* Review client records for missing or incomplete documentation

* Monitor required signatures, assessments, treatment documents, and administrative forms

* Follow up with employees regarding missing or overdue compliance items

* Track onboarding and annual compliance requirements

* Assist with employee credentialing and recredentialing documentation

* Assist with payer and provider enrollment documentation as assigned

* Organize documents for internal and external audits

* Conduct routine file audits using established checklists

* Document compliance findings and corrective actions

* Monitor deadlines and send reminders before items become overdue

* Maintain organized electronic compliance files

* Assist management with policy and procedure tracking

* Review records for consistency with company requirements

* Report significant compliance concerns to management

* Assist with corrective action follow-up

* Protect confidential information and follow HIPAA requirements



What We Are Looking For



Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:



* Healthcare compliance

* Behavioral health administration

* Medical records

* Credentialing

* Human resources compliance

* Quality assurance

* Healthcare documentation

* Medicaid provider operations

* HIPAA-related administrative work



Experience working with a U.S. healthcare or behavioral health organization** is a major advantage.



Skills Needed



The successful candidate must be:



* Extremely detail-oriented

* Highly organized

* Comfortable reviewing large amounts of documentation

* Able to identify missing, incomplete, or expired information

* Comfortable following up repeatedly when required

* Able to maintain accurate tracking systems

* Able to meet deadlines without constant supervision

* Comfortable communicating professionally with employees and management

* Able to protect confidential information

* Comfortable learning new systems and processes

* Strong in written English

* Reliable and consistent with attendance



 What Success Looks Like



We do not want someone who simply checks boxes.



We need someone who asks:



**What is missing?

What is expiring soon?

Who is responsible for correcting it?

Has the issue been resolved?

What creates a risk for the organization?

What needs to be escalated to management?**



The goal of this position is to help prevent compliance problems before they become audit findings, payment issues, employee credentialing problems, or operational risks.



Daily Compliance Expectations



The Compliance Specialist should maintain a clear record of:



* Items reviewed

* Deficiencies identified

* Employees or departments contacted

* Items corrected

* Items still outstanding

* Upcoming expiration dates

* Issues requiring management attention



Every compliance issue should have a clear status and next action.



Compensation



Starting Pay: $3.50 USD per hour



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right candidate.



Employees who demonstrate strong performance, reliability, accuracy, independent problem-solving, and the ability to manage compliance responsibilities with limited supervision may be considered for future compensation reviews and expanded responsibilities.



Schedule



Candidates must be available to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



Reliable internet, a dependable computer, and a quiet professional workspace are required.



How to Apply



Please include the following with your application:



1. A brief introduction about yourself.

2. Describe any experience you have with healthcare, compliance, credentialing, medical records, or quality assurance.

3. Have you previously worked for a U.S.-based healthcare company?

4. What systems or software have you used?

5. Describe how you would manage 50 employees with certifications and licenses that expire on different dates.

6. If you discovered that an employee's required credential expired two weeks ago, what steps would you take?

7. Describe how you stay organized when managing multiple deadlines.

8. Confirm that you are available to work during U.S. Eastern Time.





Applications that do not answer the questions above will not be prioritized.



Important



This position requires someone who is comfortable holding others accountable for completing required documentation.



You must be willing to follow up, document your efforts, identify risks, and escalate unresolved issues when necessary.



We are looking for someone who can become a dependable part of our compliance and administrative infrastructure—not someone who simply completes assigned tasks.

title: Billing & Claims Specialist

* Review EOBs, ERAs, and payment information

* Identify authorization or eligibility problems affecting claims

* Maintain accurate notes regarding claim follow-up activity

* Assist with accounts receivable and aging reports

* Escalate claims that require additional intervention

* Protect confidential patient information and follow HIPAA requirements



What We Are Looking For



Healthcare billing experience is strongly preferred.



You should understand or have experience with:



* U.S. healthcare insurance billing

* Behavioral health or mental health billing

* Medicaid claims

* CMS-1500/professional claims

* Claims submission

* Denials and rejections

* EOBs and ERAs

* Accounts receivable

* Insurance eligibility

* Prior authorizations

* Claim status follow-up

* Payment reconciliation





Skills Needed



The right person must be:



* Extremely detail-oriented

* Organized

* Able to follow a claim from submission through payment

* Comfortable communicating professionally by email and telephone

* Able to document their work clearly

* Able to recognize when something does not look correct

* Reliable and consistent with attendance

* Comfortable working during U.S. Eastern Time hours



Strong written English and professional communication skills are required.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the billing process.

Why was it denied?

Can it be corrected?

What information is missing?

Who needs to take action?

What is the next step?

Compensation

How to Apply



Please submit the following:

6. Describe how you would handle a claim that was submitted but has not been paid after 30 days.

7. Describe a denial you have handled in the past and how you resolved it.

8. Confirm that you are available to work during **U.S. Eastern Time**.





Applications that do not answer the questions above will not be prioritized.



We are looking for someone who wants to learn our organization, take ownership of our claims, and become a dependable long-term member of our administrative team.

title: Video Content Reviewer and Team Lead (YouTube)
description:
About us



We run a fast-growing YouTube channel. Each video starts as a topic, and we gather many short clips for it, pick the best ones, write narration, edit, and publish. Much of our editing uses automation and AI, which makes a careful human review even more important.



This is our first content manager role. You'll start by doing the review work yourself. As we grow, you'll hire, train, and lead a team of reviewers who report to you.





What you will do



Clip review

- Watch the clips gathered for each topic and approve or reject them

- Check each clip: is it engaging, on topic, good enough quality, and not something we've already used?

- Flag clips that may cause copyright problems or don't meet our standards



Video review

- Watch finished videos before they go live and check them against our quality standards

- Catch problems such as a clip that doesn't fit, narration over the wrong clip, audio issues, awkward cuts, or a weak opening

- Approve the video, or send it back with clear, timestamped notes the editor can act on right away

- Make small editing fixes yourself when needed



Team management

- Help us hire and train new reviewers

- Assign daily clip and video review tasks and keep work on schedule

- Check your team's work, give feedback, and make sure everyone reviews to the same standard

- Spot recurring problems and suggest ways to improve our process

- Report to the owner on progress, quality, and anything blocking the work





What we are looking for



- 2+ years of experience in video content work: YouTube, social media, video editing, or content QA

- Video editing skills (Premiere Pro or similar). You won't edit full time, but you need to understand editing well and be able to step in when needed

- A strong eye for what makes a clip engaging and what makes a video feel polished

- A good understanding of YouTube: retention, pacing, and why some videos perform better than others

- Experience leading or training people, or a clear wish to grow into that role

- Excellent written English. Your feedback needs to be short, clear, and specific

- Very organized and reliable: you meet deadlines and keep track of many tasks at once

- Comfortable learning new web-based tools quickly

- Basic knowledge of YouTube copyright and Content ID is a plus





Details



- Full-time remote work, 40 hours per week

- Starting salary around USD 1,000 per month, depending on experience. The final amount is agreed with the right candidate

- Salary grows as you take on more responsibility and the team grows

- Working hours to be agreed with the right candidate

- Long-term role with a clear path to leading a team

- You'll need a reliable internet connection fast enough to stream HD video, a computer, and a quiet place to work





How to apply



Please send:

1. A short introduction (5 to 8 sentences) about your experience with video content, video editing, and leading people

2. Links to YouTube channels or other content you've worked on, and what your role was



Start your application with the words "Clip Review Lead" so we know you read the full post. We won't consider applications without them.



Shortlisted applicants will do a short paid test: reviewing some sample clips and one finished video.

title: Direct Response Copywriter (WFH / Remote)
description:
Full-time | Remote Setup/Work from Home

Working Hours: 9AM - 6PM (SGT)

Salary: SGD 1,000+ monthly (with performance bonuses)



About the role

Trident Digital is one of the fastest growing marketing agencies for financial advisors and real estate leaders in Singapore. Our clients are top producers in their industry, and they don’t pay us for views or pretty content. They pay us for leads, booked calls and closed business.



This role is a big part of that engine. Your job is to come up with strong angles for each client, and then write everything that carries those angles: video ad scripts, image ads, landing page copy, VSL scripts, Meta ad copy, and follow-up
s and WhatsApp messages. Your work runs on live campaigns with real budgets, and you’ll know within days whether it worked. If that excites you, keep reading.



What the setup looks like

You’ll join our ads department and work alongside team members with different specialist skill sets across media buying, funnels and creative, plus our strategists and the founder. We serve a growing base of ad clients and we’re scaling fast. Main channel is Meta. Market is Singapore. Niches are financial advisory and real estate, which means trust-based selling.



What you’ll do

• Come up with strong angles for each client based on their positioning, audience and offer

• Write high converting video ad scripts, image ad copy, VSL scripts, landing page copy and Meta ad copy

• Write follow-up
s and WhatsApp messages that keep leads moving towards booked calls

• Review results weekly with the ads lead, spot the winning angles, and write the next round based on data

• Write for real Singapore FA and RE audiences based on what they actually think and want. No generic “financial freedom” filler

• Build our angle library as you go, so every winning angle compounds for the whole team



How you’ll be measured

Hit rate. Out of every batch of scripts you write, a minimum share needs to become winners: strong lead costs, campaigns that can scale. Our current bar is at least 2 winners out of every 8 video scripts. You’ll see your numbers every week. Good writers want to be measured. It’s how you prove you’re good.



You’ll do well here if you

• Care about the difference between copy that reads well and copy that converts, and chase the second

• Rewrite your own hooks before anyone asks

• Study why an ad worked, not just that it worked

• Take feedback well. Your copy gets reviewed, tested and sometimes rewritten. That’s how everyone here improves, including us



This is not for you if you

• Want a job where you clock in, clear tasks and clock out at 6 sharp

• Have freelance clients or side hustles competing for your focus. We’re not saying no life outside work. We’re saying this has to be your main thing, because split attention shows in the work

• Prefer writing from templates instead of thinking through the audience and angle each time



No hard feelings either way. We’d rather both sides know now.



Bonus points

• You’ve written copy for service professionals

• Bigger bonus: financial advisors or real estate specifically

• Biggest bonus: you’ve done it for the Singapore market



What you get

• Your work runs on live campaigns with real budgets. Fast feedback, real stakes, visible results

• Direct access to the founder and strategists. You learn how campaigns are actually planned, not just briefed

• A team that invests in growth: internal masterminds, sponsored courses, and overseas team trips

• Real room to grow into a senior copy and strategy role as we scale



How to apply



 
 with the subject line: 

Your Next Copywriter - [Your Full Name]

Your
 should include:

• Cover letter: years of copywriting experience and how you think you can contribute to Trident Digital

• Updated CV/Resume

• One short exercise: pick any ad you’ve seen that you think is weak, and rewrite the hook. A few lines is enough. We’re looking at how you think

* Create engaging, aesthetic, and high-quality short-form videos for Instagram and TikTok.

* Research current international trends, viral hooks, trending sounds, and content ideas.

* Add suitable music, captions, subtitles, transitions, and effects where needed.

* Turn simple raw footage into engaging content that attracts new viewers.

* Suggest creative ideas to improve reach, engagement, and follower growth.

* Maintain a consistent editing style that fits my personal brand.



WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR



* Previous experience working with content creators is required.

* Strong experience editing Instagram Reels and TikTok videos.

* Excellent understanding of Instagram Trial Reels, viral trends, hooks, and audience engagement.

* A great eye for clean, modern, feminine, and aesthetic content.

* Experience using CapCut, Instagram Edits, or similar editing tools.

* Very good English communication skills.

* Creative, proactive, organized, and reliable.

* Ability to work independently and meet daily deadlines.

* Comfortable working with international social media trends.



I’m not looking for someone who simply cuts videos together. I want someone who understands what makes content engaging and can bring fresh ideas to the table.



WORKING HOURS & PAYMENT



* Rate: €4 per hour

* Availability: Approximately 1–2 hours per day

* Workload: At least 3 finished Trial Reels per working day

* Location: Fully remote

* Schedule: Flexible, with reliable daily communication

* Start: As soon as possible

* Opportunity: Long-term cooperation



I will provide the raw footage and creative direction. Your responsibility will be to turn it into engaging, polished, ready-to-post content.



HOW TO APPLY

4. A short Canva presentation introducing yourself, your experience, and your editing style.

5. Your availability and earliest possible start date.

title: Short Form Video Editor for an Indie Game (Reels, TikTok & YouTube Shorts)
description:
I’m looking for someone to help me create short videos for a turn based roguelite made entirely from text and ASCII art.



The game has ten playable classes, deep character builds, and a sci-fi setting. I want videos that show people why they’d want to play it, even if they’ve never tried an ASCII game before.



**What you’ll do**



- Turn gameplay footage into vertical videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

- Come up with hooks and video ideas around combat, classes, builds, enemies, and interesting gameplay moments.

- Add captions, sound effects, and music where they help.

- Keep the gameplay readable on a phone screen.

- Create different hooks for promising clips so we can test what gets people watching.

- Work with me on feedback and revisions.



I can provide gameplay footage, screenshots, and information about the game. If you’re comfortable playing the game and recording your own clips, mention that in your application.



**Who I’m looking for**



You should have experience editing short form videos, ideally for games. You should know how to catch someone’s attention quickly and keep the video moving without covering everything in effects.



Textmor’s ASCII art is a big part of its identity. You’ll need to preserve the actual artwork and make thoughtful choices about cropping, zooming, and captions.



I’d especially like to work with someone who can suggest ideas and choose interesting moments, instead of needing instructions for every cut. An interest in indie games, roguelikes, or RPGs would help.



**Scope and pay**



This is a part time freelance role to start, with the possibility of ongoing work if we’re a good fit.



Please include your rate per video.



**How to apply**



Please send:



- Two or three examples of short videos you’ve edited, preferably gaming content.

- A brief explanation of what you handled in each example.

- Your rates, availability, and typical turnaround time.



I care more about your work and ideas than a long cover letter. If we seem like a good fit, we’ll start with a small paid trial. Please don't use AI to write your
 to me (AI writing is so generic.)

title: Viral Video Idea Researcher (Hair / Beauty, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts)
description:
START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORDS "HAIR HOOK" OR IT WON'T BE READ.



Hours: About 4 hours/day, Monday to Saturday. Pick your own hours, but the daily doc is due by 9 AM EST.

Pay: $400 USD/month to start, with a raise after 60 days for consistent, high-quality work.



=== JOB OVERVIEW ===

I run several YouTube Shorts channels in the hair and beauty space. Your whole job is to find winning video ideas every day and deliver them to me in one Google Doc. When I open the doc each morning, the ideas should be ready to use with no extra research from me.



This is NOT a content creation job. You don't film, edit, or post anything. You find the ideas, check the numbers, and present them clearly.



=== HOW THE WORK IS DONE ===

You won't just scroll randomly. You'll train dedicated TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube accounts so their feeds only show the kind of content I want:

- Follow, watch, like, and save content from a list of specific creators and accounts I'll give you

- Keep adding new accounts you discover that post in the same style

- Teach the algorithm what to show you, so your feeds are full of fresh, relevant videos every day

- Pull the best ones from those feeds into the daily doc



Once hired, I'll explain the type of ideas I want for each channel, how many per day, and which accounts to start training on.



=== WHAT MAKES AN IDEA "WINNING" ===

Specific rules vary by channel, but in general every idea must be:

- Directly related to the channel's niche (mostly hair)

- Proven: a high view count, or a high outlier score (the video's views divided by the creator's average views)

- Recent: posted within the last couple of weeks

- Filmed on a phone, but clear and high quality: good lighting, sharp, vertical

- Grabs you visually in the first 1-2 seconds, even with the sound off



=== DAILY DELIVERABLE ===

A Google Doc (one tab per day). For each idea:

1. Link to the original video

2. Platform, views, and date posted

3. Outlier score

4. Which channel it's for

5. The hook: what happens in the first second (one sentence)

6. What happens in the video (1-2 sentences)

7. The angle: the tip, correction, or twist I could add



I'll mark which ideas I use, so you'll learn quickly what wins.



=== REQUIREMENTS ===

- You spend a lot of time on TikTok / Instagram / YouTube Shorts and understand how the algorithm and recommended feeds work

- Comfortable creating and managing separate accounts just for research

- Strong English reading and writing (the "angle" notes need to be clear)

- Reliable: the doc is there every day, on time

- Comfortable with Google Docs

- Interest in hair or beauty is a big plus



=== HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY) ===

Start your application with the words "HAIR HOOK" or it won't be read.



Then answer these:

1. Send 3 hair videos posted in the last 7 days that went viral. For each, write one sentence on why the first second makes people stop scrolling.

2. In 2-3 sentences: how would you train a new TikTok account so its feed only shows viral hair content?



The best applicants get a paid trial: one full day's doc after I brief you on the channels.

ABOUT SUPERFULFILL

This position offers the opportunity to work closely with company leadership and contribute directly to important business decisions.



THE ROLE



We are looking for someone who can look at a business, understand how its departments operate, identify problems, and implement practical improvements.



You will work across multiple teams, evaluate processes and performance, and help ensure that the company operates efficiently as it grows.



This is a hands-on management position requiring independent thinking, strong judgment, leadership, and the ability to turn ideas into measurable results.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. BUSINESS OPERATIONS & PERFORMANCE

- Identify opportunities for automation and more efficient use of technology.

- Reduce unnecessary manual work and operational mistakes.

- Help create systems that can scale with the business.

- Evaluate employee productivity, performance, and accountability.

- Identify training needs and performance gaps.

- Work with department leads to improve employee effectiveness.

- Help establish clear responsibilities and performance expectations.

- Provide objective feedback and recommendations to management.

- Support the development of a high-performing team.

- Lead improvement projects involving multiple departments.

- Establish project objectives, deadlines, and success measures.

- Coordinate with relevant employees and department leads.

- Track implementation and follow through until projects are completed.

- Measure results and report improvements to management.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We are especially interested in applicants with experience in:



- Operations Management

- Business Process Improvement

- Quality Assurance Management

- Internal Auditing

- Project Management

- Performance Management

- Business Operations or Corporate Management



REQUIREMENTS



- At least 3 years of relevant management, supervisory, quality assurance, or process improvement experience.

- Proven ability to manage projects, processes, or employee performance.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong leadership, organization, and communication skills.

- Experience developing SOPs, KPIs, reports, or internal controls.

- Comfortable using spreadsheets, software, and modern business tools.

- Able to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.

- Willing to work full-time at our Davao City office.



Experience in BPO management, quality assurance, corporate operations, logistics, or other structured business environments is an advantage.



Experience in e-commerce or fulfillment is NOT required. Industry-specific training will be provided.



WHAT WE VALUE MOST



We are looking for someone who:



- Thinks independently rather than simply following instructions.

- Can identify problems before they become serious.

- Makes decisions based on evidence and measurable results.

- Understands how to improve people, processes, and systems.

- Can communicate professionally with employees and management.

- Takes responsibility for implementing improvements.

- Is comfortable challenging inefficient processes and suggesting better alternatives.

- Wants to help build and improve a growing international company.



WHY JOIN SUPERFULFILL?

- Opportunity to work closely with company leadership.

- Direct involvement in business decisions and company development.

- Exposure to international business operations and global e-commerce.

- Opportunity to design and improve company-wide systems.

- Significant responsibility and professional growth potential.

- Collaborative office environment in Davao City.

- Opportunity to progress into broader senior leadership responsibilities based on performance.



HOW TO APPLY



Please attach your updated resume and answer ALL the following questions:

title: Performance Creative Designer — Static Ads
description:
We are looking for a Performance Graphic Designer to create high-converting static ads for a fast-growing DTC beauty brand.



This role is focused on direct-response advertising — not general branding or organic social media design.



You should be able to understand a creative brief, identify the correct information hierarchy and visual format, and independently turn the strategy into a strong static ad designed for paid social.



Compensation includes a competitive monthly base salary plus performance-based bonuses for creatives that achieve meaningful results.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Create performance-focused static ads for Meta and other paid social channels based on creative briefs.

• Translate hooks, copy, offers, proof points, and product benefits into clear, compelling visual hierarchy.

• Select and adapt suitable layouts, swipe references, and proven ad formats for different creative concepts.

• Produce meaningful iterations of winning ads by testing headlines, visuals, layouts, proof elements, CTAs, and other variables.

• Use AI tools to create or edit models, facial expressions, skin details, gestures, product scenes, backgrounds, and other required assets.

• Work closely with Creative Strategists, respond quickly to feedback, and deliver organized editable files in the required formats.





REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience creating direct-response static ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.

• Strong understanding of typography, information hierarchy, readability, composition, and conversion-focused design.

• Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently — not just copy references mechanically.

• Experienced in producing multiple meaningful variations from one winning concept.

• Proficient in Figma and/or Photoshop, with strong practical experience using AI image-generation and editing tools.

• Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

• Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

• Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

• Ability to suggest controlled copy or wording variations is also a plus. 



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS BELOW. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE REQUIREMENTS MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Please include the following:



1. Your portfolio link, preferably including direct-response static ads for paid social.

2. If you have worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands, please specify the brand names and include links to relevant work.

3. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

4. What is your current work situation? Are you employed full-time, working part-time, freelancing, or currently available?

5. When would you be available to start if selected?

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

7. What design tools do you regularly use? Please specify your experience with Figma and/or Photoshop.

8. What AI image-generation or editing tools do you use? Briefly explain how you use them in your workflow.

9. From a clear creative brief with the necessary assets provided, how many NET-NEW STATIC AD CONCEPTS can you normally complete in one working day?

10. From an existing concept or winning ad, how many MEANINGFUL VARIATIONS can you normally complete in one working day?



Please do not count simple resizes or format adaptations as new creatives.



11. How long do you normally need to revise one static ad after receiving clear feedback?

12. Briefly explain how you would take one winning static ad and turn it into multiple genuinely different variations for further testing.



IMPORTANT



This role is specifically focused on performance advertising.



We are looking for designers who understand that a strong paid-social creative is not just visually attractive — it must communicate the right message quickly, establish a clear hierarchy, and support the intended conversion goal.



Applications without a relevant static-ad portfolio may not be considered.

title: Affiliate Content Manager
description:
[IMPORTANT] To apply, please fill in the application form here: 



About Crafti



Crafti is a matcha brand selling in the USA and Singapore. We are a small and fast team that prioritises output and growth. We currently have over 5 remote Filipino team members and are proud to be a remote-first company.



The Role



We're looking for an Affiliate Content Manager to grow and run our network of affiliate creators: finding the right creators, getting them excited about Crafti, and making sure the content they post actually makes people buy.



This is an analytical role, not a creative one. You don't need years of experience. What matters is that you enjoy pulling videos apart to understand why some sell and others don't, and that you keep using what you learn to make the next round better.



You'll thrive here if you:



- Watch a TikTok or Reel and naturally break down why it worked or didn't: the hook, the first 3 seconds, the format, the comments

- Care more about whether a video sold the product than whether it looked nice

- Enjoy comparing results, spotting patterns and testing small changes to see what improves

- Can juggle dozens of creator conversations across DMs,
 and WhatsApp without letting anyone slip through the cracks

- Follow up and push things forward rather than wait to be told what's next

- Learn fast and pick up new tools (including AI) on your own



Do not apply if:



- You mainly see yourself as a creative and want to make your own content. This role is about analysing and improving content, not creating it.

- You don't use TikTok or Instagram regularly yourself

- You are uncomfortable being a project manager or following up with people who go quiet

- Your written English is not clear and professional. You will be writing to creators on our behalf.



What You'll Do



- Creator Sourcing: find and reach out to creators whose audience matches ours (women aged 25–35 who are into wellness, pilates and healthy routines)

- Affiliate Management: onboard creators, send free product, agree on terms and keep every creator moving from "interested" to "posted"

- Content Briefing: write clear briefs based on what has actually worked for us and what is trending right now

- Content Review: review creator content before it goes live and give specific feedback to improve it

- Performance Analysis: track how every post performs (views, clicks, sales), work out what the winners have in common, and feed that back into the next briefs

- Trend Watching: spot formats and trends we should test, and back up your suggestions with examples of how they are performing



What We Are Looking For



Skills:



- Strong understanding of short-form content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) and what makes people buy

- Organised: comfortable keeping trackers in Google Sheets or similar

- Clear, friendly written English

- Comfortable with tech tools and AI

- Bonus (not required): experience with influencer outreach, product gifting



Traits (these matter more than your CV):



- Urgency and ownership: today's task is today's responsibility and I get it done

- Proactive communicator: if something might go wrong, I flag it early

- Has opinions: I want to suggest a better way, and I back it up with evidence





Details



This is a remote contract role based in the Philippines.



Remuneration: PHP 75,000 per month



Commitment: Contract role with the option to extend if found to be suitable

Hours: Philippine business hours, Monday to Friday, 9:30am – 6:30pm, with flexibility to reply to creators outside these hours

title: VIDEO EDITOR – DTC BEAUTY & PERSONAL CARE
description:

This role is responsible for turning creative briefs into high-performing video ads across Meta and TikTok, including UGC ads, product demonstrations, AI-generated creatives, iterations of winning concepts, and new creative experiments.



We are looking for someone who understands direct-response advertising, consumer psychology, and performance creative — not just video editing.

• Create iterations of winning ads by improving hooks, pacing, visuals, storytelling, and overall execution based on performance insights

• Develop AI-generated video content using tools such as AI avatars, AI scenes, AI animation, voiceovers, and AI-assisted editing workflows

• Maintain strong visual quality, brand consistency, and alignment with the creative strategy

• Continuously improve editing workflows to increase creative testing speed and output quality



REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience editing performance ads for DTC brands

• Experience in beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care is a strong plus

• Strong understanding of Meta and TikTok advertising formats and what makes ads convert

• Experience using AI-generated content and AI creative tools

• Ability to understand a creative brief and independently translate strategy into compelling visuals

• Strong attention to detail in pacing, storytelling, shot selection, visual logic, and overall ad quality

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with frequent creative iterations



HOW TO APPLY



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your portfolio link and CV

2. Have you worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands? If so, please specify the brand names and specify your role and length of experience.

4. Your current availability/start date

title: Performance Graphic Designer — Beauty & Skincare Ads | Relevant Portfolio Required
description:
We’re looking for a Performance Graphic Designer to create high-converting static ads for a fast-growing DTC beauty brand.



This role is focused on direct-response advertising — not general branding or organic social media design.



You should be able to understand a creative brief, identify the correct information hierarchy and visual format, and independently turn the strategy into a strong static ad designed for paid social.



Compensation includes a competitive monthly base salary plus performance-based bonuses for creatives that achieve meaningful results.





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



• Create performance-focused static ads for Meta and other paid social channels based on creative briefs.

• Translate hooks, copy, offers, proof points, and product benefits into clear, compelling visual hierarchy.

• Select and adapt suitable layouts, swipe references, and proven ad formats for different creative concepts.

• Produce meaningful iterations of winning ads by testing headlines, visuals, layouts, proof elements, CTAs, and other variables.

• Use AI tools to create or edit models, facial expressions, skin details, gestures, product scenes, backgrounds, and other required assets.

• Work closely with Creative Strategists, respond quickly to feedback, and deliver organized editable files in the required formats.



REQUIREMENTS



• Proven experience creating direct-response static ads for DTC or e-commerce brands.

• Strong understanding of typography, information hierarchy, readability, composition, and conversion-focused design.

• Able to understand and execute creative briefs independently — not just copy references mechanically.

• Experienced in producing multiple meaningful variations from one winning concept.

• Proficient in Figma and/or Photoshop, with strong practical experience using AI image-generation and editing tools.

• Strong attention to product accuracy, human anatomy, faces, hands, skin texture, lighting, and overall visual realism.

• Fast, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable with frequent creative testing and revisions.

• Beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care experience is a strong plus.

• Ability to suggest controlled copy or wording variations is also a plus. 



HOW TO APPLY



PLEASE FOLLOW ALL INSTRUCTIONS BELOW. APPLICATIONS THAT DO NOT FOLLOW THESE REQUIREMENTS MAY NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Please include the following:



1. Your portfolio link, preferably including direct-response static ads for paid social.

2. If you have worked with any beauty, skincare, cosmetics, wellness, or personal care brands, please specify the brand names and include links to relevant work.

3. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

4. What is your current work situation? Are you employed full-time, working part-time, freelancing, or currently available?

5. When would you be available to start if selected?

6. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?

7. What design tools do you regularly use? Please specify your experience with Figma and/or Photoshop.

8. What AI image-generation or editing tools do you use? Briefly explain how you use them in your workflow.

9. From a clear creative brief with the necessary assets provided, how many NET-NEW STATIC AD CONCEPTS can you normally complete in one working day?

10. From an existing concept or winning ad, how many MEANINGFUL VARIATIONS can you normally complete in one working day?



Please do not count simple resizes or format adaptations as new creatives.



11. How long do you normally need to revise one static ad after receiving clear feedback?

12. Briefly explain how you would take one winning static ad and turn it into multiple genuinely different variations for further testing.



IMPORTANT



This role is specifically focused on performance advertising.



We are looking for designers who understand that a strong paid-social creative is not just visually attractive — it must communicate the right message quickly, establish a clear hierarchy, and support the intended conversion goal.



Applications without a relevant static-ad portfolio may not be considered.

Meetings and projects: Manage meetings, projects, tasks, owners, deadlines, follow-ups, and successful implementation.

Strong organization, prioritization, and follow-up discipline.

Ability to identify operational problems and drive them to resolution.

Experience creating, improving, and enforcing SOPs.

Confidence working with CRMs, spreadsheets, trackers, and dashboards.

Ability to audit work for accuracy and completeness.

Clear and professional written and verbal communication.

Sound judgment and the ability to remain calm under pressure.

We operate two residential service companies (plumbing and electrical) on the West Side of Los Angeles. Nine years in business, currently sixteen team members. We divide roles clearly, and every person is responsible for their results.

title: Performance Video Editor (E-commerce)
description:
We're Hiring: Performance Video Editor & Creative Strategist



We're looking for a skilled, fast, and detail-oriented Video Editor to join our growing e-commerce business.



We need someone who does more than just edit videos. You should understand what makes an ad successful, stay updated on current advertising trends, and know how to turn creative ideas into high-converting video ads.



What You'll Be Doing



Create engaging video ads for
 and Instagram



Produce different creative styles, including UGC, 3D animation, Pixar-style animation, AI-generated videos, and direct-response ads.



Create B-roll and compilation-style ads using sourced footage, voiceovers, AI-generated content, and professional editing.



Use AI tools such as Google Flow and similar platforms to generate content when needed.



Research trending ads, winning hooks, creative angles, and competitor strategies.



Combine storytelling, visuals, sound effects, subtitles, and strong calls to action into complete, polished advertisements.



Suggest new creative concepts and improvements based on advertising performance.



Requirements



Minimum 3–5 years of professional video editing experience (mandatory).



Proven experience creating video ads for e-commerce brands and current social media trends.



Experience with AI video generation tools, UGC editing, animations, and different advertising formats.



Excellent attention to detail — every second of the video matters, from the opening hook to the final CTA.



Ability to deliver high-quality work quickly and consistently, without missing important details.



Strong research skills, creativity, and the ability to work independently.



Reliable communication, professionalism, and respect for deadlines.



Salary & Bonuses



Starting salary: $3,5 USD/hour.



Additional performance-based bonuses for ads achieving 2.0 ROAS or higher, according to our bonus system.



Salary review after the first month, with the possibility of increasing to $4/hour based on proven performance.





Hiring Process



Initial Skill Test: Shortlisted applicants must complete an editing test within 24 hours of receiving the assignment.



Paid Trial Period: Successful candidates will enter a paid trial period lasting 1–2 weeks.



Long-Term Opportunity: The position may initially involve approximately 30 hours per week, with the intention of transitioning to full-time (40 hours/week) within 2–4 weeks, depending on performance and business needs.

title: General Admin & Marketing Support VA | HVAC, Advanced ServiceM8
description:
Application form:



Role Overview



Candidates with advanced, hands-on ServiceM8 experience (including automations, quote follow-up sequences and SMS templates) and a background running the full job cycle for an Australian trades or field service business will be prioritised for this role.



An Australian air conditioning and refrigeration business needs a part-time VA who can step into ServiceM8 at an advanced level and take immediate ownership of the full job cycle: monitoring every enquiry channel, entering jobs, answering client questions, quoting, booking and invoicing. ServiceM8 depth is the non-negotiable. The owner uses only the basics of the platform and wants a VA who knows it better than he does, can set up the workflows and automations that aren’t being used yet, and never needs to be taught the platform itself.



The second half of the role is marketing. In quieter periods, the VA will run social media, create simple content, send
 campaigns to the client database, and run paid campaigns across Google and Meta. When bookings slow down, marketing needs to kick in to fill the schedule.



Success looks like the owner finishing on the tools and being done for the day, a schedule that keeps the technicians (and an incoming apprentice) fully booked, and a winter that is busier than the last. This coming winter is the test of whether the role moves to full-time.



What You’ll Own



Enquiry Management



Monitor all enquiry channels throughout the shift, including ServiceM8 notifications, the ServiceM8 inbox, website message enquiries and

Follow up missed calls and enquiries captured by the AI receptionist

Enter new enquiries into ServiceM8 with complete client, site and job details

Follow up clients for missing information (address, unit details, photos, access) before progressing the job

Respond to client questions promptly and clearly, escalating technical queries

Make outbound calls through the ServiceM8 phone app for important matters only, as calls are charged per minute



Quoting



Prepare and send quotes in ServiceM8

Monitor ServiceM8’s automated five-step quote follow-up sequence and act on anything it misses



Booking & Scheduling



Book accepted jobs in ServiceM8 and confirm bookings with clients

Keep the schedule as full as possible for the field team, including a trainee and an incoming apprentice

Send booking confirmations and appointment reminders

Maintain accurate job statuses from quoted through to booked and completed



Invoicing



Issue invoices from ServiceM8 on job completion (syncs automatically to Xero)

Submit invoices through the relevant real estate agency’s platform for property management jobs (such as Ourtradie/OurProperty and Tapi), confirming the correct submission method for each agency

Follow up overdue invoices



Marketing Support



Prioritise admin first, stepping up marketing activity when bookings slow to keep the schedule full

Post on
 and Instagram via Meta Business Suite, respond to comments and messages, and create simple content and video edits

Develop and send
 campaigns to the client database, such as seasonal service offers

Review the existing, currently paused Google Ads account, then plan and run paid campaigns across Google and Meta

Submit all new marketing activity for approval before it goes live



Daily Communication & Systems



Send a start-of-shift WhatsApp message confirming log-on and the day’s priorities

Send an end-of-day
 report covering tasks completed, work in progress, and items needing approval, attention or review

title: Aged Care Rostering Support Co-ordinator (NDIS / Aged Care Industry)
description:
About the Role



We are seeking an Aged Care Rostering Support Co-ordinator to join our team. This is a non-clinical role

coordinating and rostering approved participant services, maintaining accurate records, managing

workflow follow up, and escalating issues where needed. The role is designed to support the Senior Care

Partner team by ensuring day to day care administration is actioned accurately, efficiently, and in line

with approved care plans, budgets, and internal processes. The purpose of the role is co-ordinating the

activities of daily living delivering quality care management services through the Support at Home

program for our aged care participants. Working closely with participants, families and various health

professionals you ensure services reflect each participant's assessed needs, preferences and available

funding.



The ideal candidate has very strong English speaking and writing skills. You are proactive, have high

degree of empathy, are detail oriented while communicating clearly and confidently. You have a passion

for making a difference in care participants lives, being part of a supportive team, rostering caregiver

schedules in the Support at Home program ensuring every care participant receives the care they

deserve. You'll manage shift changes and rosters along with administrative and financial areas of the

business so experience with Xero is an advantage.



You’ll enjoy a hybrid role work environment that fosters teamwork and professional growth. With

shared working schedule between our Cebu IT Park location and remotely from your home office.



Key Responsibilities include:



1. Task Processing and Administration

• Receive participant related requests and task handovers from the Senior Care Partner

• Convert instructions into clear actions and system updates

• Enter requests accurately into the relevant care or workflow system

• Process service bookings, cancellations, purchases, referrals, and invoice approval tasks

• Check care plan and budget alignment before actioning requests



2. Service Request Co-ordination

• Book approved participant services in line with care plans

• Liaise with rostering teams, providers, and internal stakeholders

• Confirm worker availability and participant preferences

• Resolve scheduling issues, changes, missed services, and escalate service issues promptly



3. Documentation and System Accuracy

• Record all actions, changes, and communications accurately

• Ensure documentation is complete, current, and audit ready

• Support strong system accuracy across participant tasks and service updates



4. Care Plan and Budget Support

• Action services only where they align with approved care plans and support arrangements

• Check that services are approved and funding is available before proceeding

• Identify and report budget risks, over-utilization, or unapproved requests

• Support the Senior Care Partner with accurate service and usage information



5. Participant and Provider Communication

• Confirm bookings, changes, and cancellations with participants and providers

• Provide general non clinical updates and service information

• Follow up providers on outstanding services or delivery issues

• Maintain professional and timely communication at all times



6. Monitoring and Escalation

• Track task completion, service progress, and outstanding actions

• Report delays, service gaps, and risks to the Senior Care Partner

• Escalate clinical issues, safeguarding concerns, service failures, and urgent matters

• Support reporting and workflow follow up to keep services on track



7. Ongoing Care Support

• Assist with monthly care management administration activities

• Support service monitoring and approved changes

• Help coordinate allied health, nursing, and community support services

• Support participant goals and independence focused service delivery



8. Review and Administrative Support

• Prepare supporting documents for support plan or service reviews when required

• Compile current services, budget usage, and care notes

• Maintain trackers, reports, and workflow systems

• Support audit preparation and internal administration



Qualifications

• Minimum 2+ years working with Australian Aged Care, NDIS or Allied Health industry

• Diploma or tertiary level qualification in Community Services, Aged Care, Case Management

• Experience in care partner administration, scheduling / rostering, healthcare or NDIS support

• Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with people at all levels.

• Excellent written and spoken English skills.

• Experience in Xero accounting (desirable)

• Reliable, proactive, and detail-oriented with solid multi-tasking skills.

• Knowledge of home care regulations, industry standards, and best practices.

• High attention to detail and data accuracy

• Ability to follow structured workflows, prioritise work and meet deadlines

• Compassionate, adaptable, and confident, working autonomously



Experience in one or more of the following will be highly regarded:

• Aged care, home care or disability / community services

• NDIS / healthcare administration



What We Offer

• Full-time employment with competitive salary & benefits

• Hybrid work arrangement remote WFH and from Cebu IT Park office

• Government mandated sick leave and vacation leave

• Government mandated benefits employer share

• Standard benefits including 13th month pay.

• Health Maintenance Organization (HMO) benefits.

• Company-provided laptop for work use.

• Standard benefits including 13th month pay.



Work Schedule

• Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM (GMT+08:00 Manila time)

• Hybrid role based in Cebu City, with work locations in Cebu Business Park and IT Park

title: Customer Support Specialist (Nutrition/Dietetics)
description:
About fatsecret



Headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, fatsecret is a leading digital health company helping millions of people around the world achieve their weight loss, nutrition, and wellness goals.



We're growing and looking for a Customer Support Specialist (Nutrition) to join our Marketing and Customer Engagement team. If you're a qualified dietitian or nutritionist who enjoys helping people, solving problems, and delivering exceptional customer experiences, we'd love to hear from you.



This is a remote role open only to candidates currently based in Metro Manila or nearby provinces (including Rizal, Cavite, Laguna, Bulacan, and Pampanga). While the position is primarily work-from-home, team members are expected to attend occasional in-person team meetups and company events.



About the Role



As a Customer Support Specialist (Nutrition), you'll be the first point of contact for customers who need assistance using the fatsecret app and our programs.



You'll help users navigate app features, answer nutrition-related questions, troubleshoot issues, and provide guidance that supports their health and wellness journey. You'll also work closely with our Product, Dietetics, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to identify recurring issues, share customer insights, and improve the overall user experience.



This role is ideal for someone who combines a strong nutrition background with excellent customer service skills and enjoys working directly with users to solve problems.



What You'll Do



Customer Support

- Respond to customer inquiries via
 and support channels.

- Help customers understand and use app features, meal plans, food tracking tools, and nutrition programs.

- Investigate and troubleshoot user-reported issues.

- Provide accurate nutrition-related guidance within established support protocols.

- Escalate technical, product, or clinical concerns when appropriate.

- Maintain high standards for customer satisfaction and first-contact resolution.



Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Communicate customer feedback, trends, and recurring issues to relevant stakeholders.

- Help identify opportunities to improve the product and user experience.

- Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Dietetics teams to resolve customer issues.



Knowledge Management

- Create and maintain FAQs, help articles, troubleshooting guides, and other support documentation.

- Identify common customer questions and propose improvements to existing resources.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of support processes.



What We're Looking For



Required

- Degree in Nutrition, Dietetics, Nutrition Science, or a related field.

- Registered Dietitian, Registered Nutritionist, Licensed Nutritionist-Dietitian, or equivalent professional qualification preferred.

- 2+ years of customer support, customer service, healthcare support, or other client-facing experience.

- Excellent written English communication skills.

- Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.

- Comfortable learning and explaining software products and mobile applications.

- Ability to communicate nutrition concepts clearly and empathetically to a broad audience.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

- Reliable high-speed internet connection and a dedicated home office setup.



Highly Desirable

- Experience supporting users in a health, wellness, nutrition, fitness, or healthcare environment.

- Experience writing customer-facing documentation, educational content, or knowledge-base articles.

- Familiarity with calorie counting, food tracking, weight management, or behaviour change programs.

- Experience using customer support platforms, ticketing systems, or CRM tools.

- Experience with mobile apps or digital health products.



Why Join fatsecret?

- Work-from-home arrangement within Metro Manila and surrounding provinces.

- Quarterly in-person team meetups with our Manila-based team.

- Working hours aligned with Melbourne, Australia: 9:00am – 5:00pm AEST

- Small, collaborative team with global reach and meaningful impact.

- Fun virtual events, game nights, and opportunities to connect with colleagues around the world.

- Complimentary access to the Premium fatsecret app.



How to Apply

- Please submit your resume and answer the following questions:



1. Why are you interested in working at fatsecret?

2. A customer writes:



"I don't know how to add food to my diary."



Write the
 response you would send to help this customer.



3. What city and province are you currently located in?



Please note: We are only considering applicants who are currently based in Metro Manila or nearby provinces.



Applications that do not include a resume and responses to all questions above will not be considered.

title: Amazon Wholesale VA / Brand Sourcer / Supplier Outreach Specialist
description:
About the Role:



I’m looking for a reliable and motivated Amazon Wholesale Virtual Assistant to join my team and help grow my Amazon business.



The ideal candidate has experience with the Amazon Wholesale business model, particularly in brand sourcing, supplier research, distributor sourcing, and supplier outreach.



You should be comfortable identifying profitable wholesale opportunities, researching brands and distributors, analyzing Amazon listings, and reaching out to potential suppliers to open wholesale accounts.



I’m looking for someone who can become a long-term member of the team, continuously improve their sourcing skills, and consistently help us build strong supplier relationships and profitable wholesale opportunities.



What you’ll do:

As an Amazon Wholesale VA, your main responsibilities will include:



- Researching profitable brands and products to sell on Amazon

- Finding authorized distributors, wholesalers, and direct brand opportunities

- Conducting brand and supplier research

- Reaching out to brands, distributors, and suppliers via email, phone, or contact forms

- Following up with suppliers and tracking responses

- Requesting wholesale applications, catalogs, price lists, and account information

- Analyzing supplier price lists for profitable Amazon opportunities

- Reviewing Amazon listings, Buy Box history, sales rank, competition, and pricing trends

- Analyzing Keepa graphs and historical product data

- Using SellerAmp SAS and other wholesale research tools to evaluate ROI, profit, fees, competition, and sales potential

- Checking whether brands and products meet our sourcing criteria

- Organizing brands, suppliers, contacts, price lists, and product leads in Google Sheets

- Maintaining accurate records of supplier outreach and account status

- Communicating regularly about progress, opportunities, and challenges



What I’m Looking For

- Experience with the Amazon Wholesale business model

- Experience with brand sourcing and supplier research

- Experience contacting brands, distributors, and wholesalers

- Strong understanding of Keepa

- Experience using SellerAmp SAS

- Ability to analyze Amazon listings and product profitability

- Experience reviewing wholesale price lists

- Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central

- Strong Google search and online research skills

- Proficiency with Google Sheets and Google Workspace

- Good written and verbal communication skills

- Professional supplier outreach and follow-up skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to follow sourcing criteria and SOPs

- Ability to work independently

- Reliable and professional work ethic

- Willingness to learn and continuously improve



Experience with tools such as SmartScout, ScanUnlimited, RevSeller, or similar Amazon Wholesale tools is a plus.



There will also be opportunities to learn additional Amazon Wholesale skills as you grow within the role.



To apply for the job:

1. Change the subject line to 'I want to be your Amazon Wholesale VA'

2. In the first 2-3 sentences of your message, tell us what excites you most about this role and what makes you a great fit.

3. Then, answer these questions with the numbers:



A) Describe your experience with Amazon Wholesale, preferably with brand sourcing, distributor research, and supplier outreach. Be specific about the tasks you handled.



B) If a supplier sends you a price list with hundreds or thousands of products, explain how you would analyze it and identify profitable opportunities.



C) What makes you stand out from other applicants? What unique value would you bring to the team?



Note: Only applicants who follow ALL instructions will be considered.



I look forward to reading what you provide.



Thank you!
