title: Paid Ads Specialist (Google & Meta)
description:
Paid Ads Specialist (GooJob Title: Performance Marketing Manager

 Location: Remote

 Job Type: Full-time

About Wandering Lion

Wandering Lion is a strategy-led growth studio helping founder-led businesses build premium brands, install scalable growth systems, and generate measurable commercial outcomes — without chaos. We do not sell marketing activity for the sake of it. We build structured growth systems that connect brand, performance, systems, and reporting to real business results.

Our model is disciplined: foundation first, then build, then scale. That means we care deeply about clarity, accountability, and making sure paid media works inside a stronger commercial system — not in isolation.

The Role

We are looking for a commercially sharp Performance Marketing Manager to lead campaign execution, optimisation, and channel development across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other current or emerging paid acquisition platforms.

This role is not limited to today’s core channels. As the business grows, this position may also support expansion into additional advertising ecosystems, marketing technology, AI-enabled tools, automation platforms, and other digital growth systems that improve performance, reporting, and operational efficiency.

This is not a button-pushing media buying role. We want someone who understands that ads amplify clarity — they do not create it — and who can help translate strategy into efficient, measurable growth.

You will work across founder-led brands that need more than clicks and impressions. They need disciplined media execution, better conversion performance, clearer reporting, and someone who understands the commercial outcome behind the spend. Our ideal clients value structure, proof, and accountability, so your work must reflect that standard.

Key Responsibilities

Paid media strategy and planning

 Build channel strategies across Google, Meta, and other relevant paid platforms based on client goals, audience behaviour, customer journey stage, and conversion priorities.

Campaign setup and execution

 Launch, manage, and optimise campaigns across search, display, remarketing, paid social, and future paid channels where appropriate.

Audience, keyword, and market research

 Conduct keyword research, audience segmentation, competitor review, and targeting refinement to improve efficiency and lead quality.

Creative and messaging alignment

 Work closely with strategy and creative to ensure ad messaging reflects the brand, strengthens trust, and supports conversion.

Testing and optimisation

 Run structured tests across headlines, copy, creative, offers, landing pages, audience segments, and funnel stages to improve performance over time.

Budget and bid management

 Allocate spend carefully, adjust bids based on performance, and manage budgets with commercial discipline.

Performance reporting

 Translate campaign and funnel data into clear reporting that explains what happened, what it means, and what we do next.

Technology and AI adoption

 Help identify and implement useful tools, AI software, automation workflows, and platform enhancements that improve campaign performance, efficiency, internal reporting, or client delivery.

Conversion and systems thinking

 Monitor lead quality, conversion paths, attribution, and funnel performance — not just platfor
trics — to support real business outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

Proven experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts with measurable results

Strong understanding of paid media fundamentals, attribution, conversion tracking, and optimisation

Confidence learning and adapting to new advertising platforms, AI tools, and digital systems as the role evolves

Ability to think beyond platfor
trics and connect spend to commercial outcomes

Strong communication skills and the ability to explain performance clearly

A structured, accountable, detail-driven approach to campaign management

Comfort working in a business that values quality over volume and clarity over noise

Preferred

Experience across service-based businesses, eCommerce, trades, or founder-led brands

Familiarity with landing page optimisation and CRO principles

Experience using AI tools, automation platforms, reporting dashboards, or workflow software to improve marketing operations

Google Ads certifications

Meta advertising certifications

Experience using CRM, analytics, and reporting platforms

What Success Looks Like in This Role

Campaigns are well-structured, well-managed, and commercially aligned

Reporting is clear, useful, and trusted by clients

Paid media performance improves through disciplined testing and optimisation

Useful tools and systems are introduced where they genuinely improve efficiency or outcomes

Clients feel confident that spend is being managed with accountability

You contribute to a premium client experience, not just campaign delivery

Why Join Wandering Lion

You’ll be joining a business built around calm authority, commercial clarity, and human confidence. We are not trying to become a high-volume agency. We are building a quality-protected growth studio that integrates brand, performance, and systems under one roof.

That means:

You’ll work on higher-quality engagements

You’ll be part of a strategy-led model, not random execution

You’ll collaborate with a team that values standards, structure, and outcomes

You’ll help build growth systems that genuinely move businesses forward

Before We Proceed

Before we potentially move to the interview stage, we’d like to gather a few details to make sure the role is a strong fit and that you’ll be set up for success working remotely with our team.

1. PC / Laptop specifications + internet speed

 Please share your device specifications, including CPU, RAM, and storage, along with a recent internet speed test result. Reliable performance and strong internet are essential for day-to-day work.

2. Current employment or side work

 Are you currently employed or doing any freelance or side work? We are open to offshore tea
mbers having multiple roles. What matters most to us is transparency, so we understand your typical schedule and can support you properly.

3. Hubstaff tracker

 Are you comfortable using Hubstaff time tracking? Our whole team operates remotely, including our field and admin staff in Australia. Hubstaff helps us understand time allocation across projects, improve internal reporting, and provide clearer updates to clients.

4. Working hours / availability

 Can you commit to the required hours? Our standard workdays are Monday to Friday, generally within 9:00am–5:00pm Philippines time. We offer reasonable flexibility — family and life come first — but we do need consistency and clear communication.

5. Expected salary (PHP)

 If this differs from what was listed in the advert, please confirm your expected salary in PHP.

6. CV / Resume

 Please attach your CV if you have not already done so.

7. Relevant training / courses

 Please include any relevant training, certifications, or courses you have completed.

8. English level

 Please confirm your English level (C1 or C2) and your confidence in both written and spoken English.

Team Context

For context, we currently have a team of 10 people in the Philippines, all working from home, and we are continuing to grow. We value honesty, transparency, and teamwork. We are looking for people who are humble, reliable, and easy to work with — because every role matters, and the most important thing is a happy team doing work they enjoy, surrounded by like-minded people.

How to Apply

Please send your CV, a short introduction, and responses to the questions above, along with 2–3 examples of accounts, campaigns, platforms, or systems you have worked on and the commercial outcomes achieved.

Thank you. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Shopify Plus Content and Catalogue Manager (B2B) | Full Onsite
description:
Dear valued candidate, ** please answer the questions at the end after reading the job description ** 



Please note that this is a Full Onsite role and we are located at Mandaluyong City (Landmark is the City Hall)



The Shopify Plus Content & Catalogue Manager is responsible for the structure, accuracy, optimisation, and performance of the company’s Shopify product catalogue and collection architecture.

This role owns product data integrity, on-site SEO execution, internal linking logic, and digital merchandising to improve navigation clarity, search visibility, and conversion performance for B2B buyers.

• This is not a social media or paid ads role.

• This is not a developer role.

• This is a catalogue, structure, and optimisation role.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product & Catalogue Management

• Create, update, and maintain product listings (titles, descriptions, variants, images, PDFs).

• Expertise in bulk data management using Shopify CSVs or third-party tools (e.g., Matrixify/Excelify) to manage complex price updates, variant shifts, and mass metafield imports.

• Manage complex variant structures (single units, boxes, cartons, pallet layers).

• Maintain metafields, tags, and product data consistency.

• Ensure naming conventions align with SEO and B2B buying behaviour.

• Prevent duplicate content and structural inconsistencies.

2. Collection & Site Architecture

• Build and maintain logical collection hierarchies.

• Optimise category structures for clarity and search indexing.

• Implement smart collections and filtering systems.

• Maintain internal linking between related products and categories.

• Improve navigation for large SKU environments.

3. On-Site SEO Execution

• Optimise product titles, meta descriptions, and URLs.

• Manage redirects and canonical structures.

• Identify keyword opportunities relevant to B2B search intent.

• Collaborate on structured data/schema implementation (via apps or theme settings).

4. Digital Merchandising

• Optimise collection layouts.

• Improve cross-sell and related product logic.

• Support bulk purchasing strategy visibility (carton/pallet options).

• Manage B2B-specific catalogue logic, including quantity breaks, wholesale pricing tiers, and "Unit of Measure" displays (e.g., Price per Litre or Price per Pallet).

• Monitor product visibility and ranking within collections.

5. Performance Monitoring

• Use Shopify Analytics and GA4 to:

o Monitor product performance

o Identify underperforming collections

o Improve bounce and engagement metrics

• Propose structured improvements based on data.

6. App & Backend Management

• Manage Shopify apps (installation, removal, configuration).

• Test updates before publishing.

• Coordinate with developers where required (no coding required but must understand limitations).

Required Experience

• Minimum 5 years hands-on Shopify-focused experience (Required).

• Minimum 6–8 years total eCommerce experience preferred.

• Experience managing 1,000+ SKUs.

• Strong understanding of:

o Shopify product architecture & Metafields

o Collections (manual & automated)

o Redirect logic & Canonical handling

• Experience in B2B or technical product environments highly preferred.

• Strong structural thinking and taxonomy understanding.

Not Expected

This role does NOT include:

• Custom theme development

• Paid advertising management

• Social media management

• Advanced technical SEO (server-side issues)

• Full UX redesign ownership

•
 marketing automation

KPIs for This Role

1. Catalogue Accuracy & Integrity

• < 1% product data error rate

• 100% compliance with naming convention standards

• Zero duplicate URL or indexing conflicts introduced

• All new products live within agreed SLA (e.g., 48 hours)

2. SEO & Structure Improvement

• Increase indexed product pages without duplication

• Growth in non-branded organic traffic

• Improvement in category ranking positions

• Clean redirect mapping for discontinued products

3. Conversion & Merchandising Metrics

• Improvement in collection conversion rate

• Improvement in product page engagement time

• Increased cross-sell attachment rate

• Increased bulk/carton selection ratio

4. Operational Efficiency

• Time to publish new products

• Accuracy of bulk uploads (Zero-error imports)

• Clean metafield structure compliance

• Reduction in manual rework due to errors



Test: Questions for candidates to answer

1. Shopify experience: How many years of hands-on Shopify/Shopify Plus Admin experience do you have? Please list the Shopify areas/parts you have managed directly.

2. Bulk catalogue update: We need to update prices, product titles, and custom specification fields for 800+ Shopify SKUs. What method would you use?

3. Metafields / tags/catalogue structure: Give an example of how you have used Shopify metafields, tags, collections, variants, or product data fields to improve catalogue structure, filtering, SEO, or customer experience.

4. Product variants and channel management: How would you manage products sold in different sizes, fragrances, colours, pack quantities, or bundle options across Shopify and eBay while keeping the catalogue clean and easy to manage?

5. QA checklist: What checks would you complete before publishing a new product or bulk product update live on Shopify and eBay?

6. AI workflow: How do you use AI tools for eCommerce product content? Please explain your workflow from supplier data to final published copy.

7. Incomplete supplier data question: If supplier product data is incomplete, inconsistent, or unclear, what is your process for fixing it? What would you verify yourself, what would you not assume, and when would you escalate to the team?

8. Please rewrite the rough supplier product information below into a Shopify product title, short description, five bullet points, SEO title, and meta description. Also list what information you would not include unless verified.



Supplier Product Name: OXY POWER CLEANER / STAIN REMOVER 5LTR

Brand: Kleenmax

SKU: OXY-5L

Barcode: not supplied

Pack Size: 5L bottle

Carton may be 4 bottles? Need confirm

Product Type: Cleaning chemical/stain remover/deodoriser

Supplier Notes: “Strong oxygen cleaning formula. Good for offices, bathrooms, bins, kitchens, tiles, grout, carpets, upholstery maybe. Removes stains and smells. Safer than bleach. Eco friendly. Kills 99.9% germs. Hospital grade. Food safe. Can use everywhere. Dilute 1:10 or use direct for heavy stains. Lemon smell or no fragrance? Need check label. Works on urine smell and organic stains.”

Usage Notes: Can be used by cleaners, offices, schools, childcare, gyms, hospitality, commercial bathrooms.

Use on washable hard surfaces.

May be suitable for carpet spotting but should test first.

Warnings: Do not mix with chlorine bleach. Wear gloves. Check SDS before use. Patch test on delicate surfaces.

Supplier Image Notes: Image shows 5L bottle, but old image says “Oxy Active Cleaner 3L”. Need new image.

title: General Virtual Assistant and Leadership Team Member (US Company)
description:
ABOUT US



We’re a small US medical education company that has been helping pediatricians pass their board exams for over fifteen years.



We’re an established business, but in many ways, we still operate with the energy and flexibility of a startup. Our team is small, people wear more than one hat, and we genuinely support one another. We work closely together, and maintaining a positive, collaborative environment is something we really value.



WHAT THIS JOB IS



We’re looking for someone who can take on two important parts of the business, and we want to be clear about what both involve.



The first is general support. This means helping wherever the team needs you most, whether that’s following up with vendors, keeping projects moving, handling logistics, or picking up tasks that have been waiting for attention. Some responsibilities will be routine, and that’s part of keeping a small business running smoothly.



The second is something you don’t often find in a typical VA role.



We’d love for you to be part of our leadership discussions. As a small team, we regularly exchange ideas about marketing, sales, pricing, and opportunities for expansion. We’re looking for someone who can bring their own experience, perspectives, and ideas to those conversations.



We want someone who enjoys thinking about the bigger picture but is equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves and getting things done.



We’re also preparing to launch a second product, a mobile app in a new market. Helping move that project forward will likely be one of your biggest responsibilities early on.



WHAT YOU’D BE DOING



* Supporting the team with different operational and administrative needs as priorities change.

* Keeping multi-step projects moving, particularly those involving external vendors and deadlines.

* Helping coordinate and drive the launch of our new mobile app.

* Participating in leadership discussions and sharing ideas about marketing, sales, expansion, and business growth.

* Helping revisit projects that have stalled and finding ways to move them forward.

* Documenting processes and workflows so we can work more efficiently as a team.

* Coordinating with specialists and contractors across different time zones.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



* Management or leadership experience. You won’t be directly managing people in this role, but we’d love someone who has worked at that level and can bring that perspective to the team.

* Experience in online business or e-commerce. If you’ve helped operate, manage, or grow an online business, we’d especially love to hear about it.

* Some marketing exposure. You don’t need to be a marketing expert, but you should feel comfortable contributing to marketing discussions.

* Flexibility. You enjoy being involved in both strategic conversations and everyday operational work. Both are equally important to us.

* Clear communication. We appreciate people who can communicate their thoughts and updates clearly and concisely.

* A willingness to ask questions. If something in a brief is unclear, we’d much rather you ask than feel you have to figure everything out on your own.

* Openness to feedback. We believe feedback is part of working well together. We value people who can take suggestions positively, make adjustments, and keep moving forward.

* Availability that overlaps meaningfully with US Eastern and Hawaii working hours. This is an important requirement for the role.



ABOUT AI (PLEASE READ!)



We use AI extensively in our business, including AI agents that help us with real work every day.



But here’s something we want to make clear: You don’t need prior experience with AI agents to apply.



If you’ve used ChatGPT or Claude occasionally but haven’t explored more advanced AI tools, that’s completely fine.



We’re happy to teach you how we use these technologies, and you’ll have access to some powerful tools along the way.



We actually see this as one of the exciting parts of joining our team. You’ll have opportunities to learn practical AI skills and gain experience with tools that are becoming increasingly valuable across different industries.



What matters most to us is your experience, how you think, how you approach your work, and what you can bring to the team.







HOW TO APPLY



We’d love to get to know you a little better!



You don’t need to write a lengthy cover letter. A few thoughtful paragraphs are more than enough, and we appreciate clear, concise answers.



Please tell us three things:

1. Tell us about a project you managed from start to finish. What challenges came up, and how did you handle them?

2. Share a time when you misunderstood a brief or task. What happened, and how did you address it?

3. What experience or perspective would you bring to a conversation about growing an online business?



Please also include your LinkedIn profile and your Upwork profile, if you have one. We review applicants’ work histories, so having these links upfront helps make the process easier for everyone.



We read every application and appreciate hearing about your actual experiences. There’s no need for a perfectly polished or generic response. We’d much rather hear from you in your own words.



We look forward to getting to know you!

Available to work 1:00 PM – 9:00 PM Pacific Time, five days per week

Pay

- $3 USD per hour, plus a $30 USD bonus for each business that signs up

- Paid weekly through OnlineJobs.ph EasyPay



You need

- Clear, friendly spoken English and at least 1 year of outbound or B2B calling experience

- A quiet place to work, a headset and reliable internet

title: B2B SaaS Appointment Setter / Cold Caller
description:
Business Development Manager - Executive (Remote)



BinDrop.Ai

Location: Edmonton, Alberta (Company HQ)

Position Type: part time | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM (MT)

Experience Required: Minimum 7 years in software sales & business development



About OneZero Software and BinDrop.AI



B2B Sales Development Representative (SDR) / Appointment Setter



Company: BinDrop.ai

Location: Remote – Philippines

Job Type: Part-Time (20 hours/week, with potential for full-time)

Salary: $8–$12 USD/hour + Performance Bonuses

Schedule: US/Canadian Business Hours



About Us



BinDrop is a Canadian software company offering an affordable operations management platform for dumpster rental, waste management, and equipment rental businesses across North America.



Our software helps companies manage bookings, customers, scheduling, dispatching, and daily operations—all in one platform.



We are expanding into the US and Canadian markets and looking for an experienced, motivated B2B Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help us generate leads and schedule software demonstrations with potential customers.



What You’ll Do



We are looking for someone who can manage the entire lead generation and appointment-setting process independently.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Research and identify potential customers, primarily small and medium-sized dumpster rental and waste management companies.

* Find business owners, managers, and key decision-makers.

* Make outbound cold calls to introduce our software and generate interest.

* Send personalized follow-up
s and LinkedIn messages.

* Identify customer needs and qualify potential leads.

* Schedule software demonstrations with interested business owners.

* Manage leads, follow-ups, and appointments using our CRM.

* Maintain accurate records and provide weekly performance reports.



Your primary goal is to book qualified software demonstrations with business owners who are genuinely interested in our platform.



Requirements



* Minimum 5 years of B2B cold-calling or appointment-setting experience.

* Previous experience with SaaS or software sales is highly preferred.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Confident communicating with US and Canadian business owners.

* Proven ability to generate leads and book qualified appointments.

* Experience using CRM software such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or Salesforce.

* Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently.

* Reliable internet connection, headset, and quiet workspace.

* Availability during North American business hours.



Experience selling to construction, logistics, equipment rental, or service-based businesses is an advantage.



Compensation & Benefits



* $8–$12 USD/hour, depending on experience.

* $20 bonus for each qualified demo that is attended.

* $50 bonus for each new paying customer acquired through your appointments.

* Opportunities for additional performance incentives.

* Potential for long-term employment and full-time hours.

* Training, CRM access, and sales tools provided.



Performance Expectations



Our initial weekly targets are:



* Research 75–100 potential companies.

* Make 150–250 outbound calls.

* Generate meaningful conversations with decision-makers.

* Book 3–5 qualified software demonstrations.

* Maintain accurate CRM records and consistent follow-ups.



We value quality appointments and real business opportunities over call volume alone.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your resume and a brief introduction.

2. A 60–90-second voice recording introducing yourself and describing your sales experience.

3. Your previous B2B cold-calling or SaaS appointment-setting experience.

4. How many qualified appointments you typically booked per week in your previous role.

5. Your experience with CRM systems.

6. Your expected hourly rate and availability to work North American business hours.

title: GHL Automation & CRM Specialist
description:
# WE'RE HIRING!

## GoHighLevel (GHL) Automation & CRM Specialist

**CRM Management | Workflow Development | Business Automation | Systems Optimization**



**Employment Type:** Part-Time with Full-Time Advancement Opportunity  

**Reports To:** Chief Executive Officer (CEO)  

**Initial Performance Evaluation:** 60 Days



### About the Position



We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented and forward-thinking GoHighLevel (GHL) Automation & CRM Specialist to support the continued growth and operational efficiency of our three companies:



Our companies currently utilize YBW EpiCenter, our branded GoHighLevel CRM platform, with established workflows, pipelines and automations.



The selected candidate will be responsible for evaluating, enhancing, expanding and maintaining our existing systems while identifying additional opportunities to automate business operations, improve customer experiences, increase conversions and reduce manual administrative tasks.



We are not looking for someone who needs step-by-step instructions to build every workflow. We are seeking an experienced professional who can understand our business objectives, execute the CEO's vision and proactively recommend solutions that improve how our companies operate.



This position will begin part-time with the potential to transition into a full-time position based on performance, productivity and contributions to company growth.



### Key Responsibilities



**CRM & Existing Automation Management**

- Conduct a comprehensive audit of existing GHL subaccounts, workflows, pipelines and automations.

- Identify gaps, inefficiencies, errors and redundant processes.

- Optimize and expand existing workflows without disrupting current business operations.

- Troubleshoot automation errors and technical issues.

- Maintain organized CRM environments across all three companies.

- Establish consistent naming conventions for workflows, tags, triggers and custom fields.



**Workflow & Automation Development**

- Create advanced workflows based on company objectives.

- Develop conditional logic, triggers, actions and automated task assignments.

- Build lead nurturing and follow-up sequences.

- Automate lead distribution and appointment scheduling.

- Create internal notifications, reminders and escalation procedures.

- Develop customer onboarding and offboarding automations.

- Automate pipeline stage changes and milestone communications.

- Develop customer retention, reactivation and referral campaigns.

- Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive administrative tasks.



**Sales & Marketing Automation**

- Build automated lead capture and qualification systems.

- Develop automated
 and SMS campaigns.

- Create behavior-based automations based on customer engagement.

- Optimize sales funnels, forms, surveys and appointment calendars.

- Develop strategies to increase lead-to-application and client conversion rates.

- Automate referral partner onboarding, communication and follow-up.

- Collaborate with the marketing team to support lead generation initiatives.



**System Integrations & Data Management**

- Integrate GoHighLevel with third-party software and applications.

- Utilize Zapier, Make, webhooks and APIs as appropriate.

- Configure custom fields, tags and data mapping.

- Establish processes to minimize duplicate contacts and data inconsistencies.

- Maintain appropriate data security, access controls and communication consent requirements.

- Test all integrations and automations before deployment.



**Strategic Planning & Process Improvement**

- Identify additional business processes that could benefit from automation.

- Present proactive recommendations to the CEO.

- Develop automation solutions that improve productivity, profitability and scalability.

- Collaborate with department team members to understand operational challenges.

- Document workflows and create standard operating procedures.

- Maintain a centralized inventory of active automations.

- Provide weekly progress reports outlining completed projects, outstanding tasks and recommendations.



### Required Qualifications



- Minimum of two years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience.

- Advanced knowledge of GHL workflows and automation capabilities.

- Experience managing multiple subaccounts.

- Strong understanding of triggers, conditional logic, pipelines, opportunities, tags and custom fields.

- Experience with third-party integrations and data mapping.

- Experience developing sales, marketing and operational automations.

- Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to troubleshoot complex workflow issues independently.

- Ability to follow leadership directives while contributing strategic recommendations.

- Excellent communication and documentation skills.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and meet established deadlines.



### Preferred Qualifications



- Experience working with mortgage companies, financial services, real estate or business consulting firms.

- Experience with Zapier, Make, APIs and webhooks.

- Experience developing automated reporting systems and dashboards.

- Experience with AI-powered business automation.

- Knowledge of
 deliverability, A2P 10DLC and SMS compliance.

- Experience creating GHL snapshots and scalable automation templates.

- Experience developing standard operating procedures.



### Documented Experience Is Required



Candidates must provide examples of previous GoHighLevel projects demonstrating their technical expertise, including:



- Screenshots or video demonstrations of advanced workflows.

- Examples of CRM systems they have built or optimized.

- Examples of third-party integrations.

- Examples of automation challenges they have successfully resolved.

- Documented improvements in operational efficiency, time savings or customer conversions, where available.



Confidential client information may be redacted.



We are seeking candidates with practical, hands-on experience rather than individuals who have only completed GoHighLevel training courses.



### 60-Day Performance Evaluation



The selected candidate will undergo a formal performance evaluation within the first 60 days of employment.



Performance will be evaluated based on:



- Successful assessment of existing CRM infrastructure.

- Identification and resolution of workflow inefficiencies.

- Quality and functionality of newly developed automations.

- Reduction in repetitive manual tasks.

- Accuracy and reliability of workflows and integrations.

- Quality of documentation and standard operating procedures.

- Ability to independently identify improvement opportunities.

- Productivity, accountability and adherence to deadlines.

- Strategic recommendations that contribute to company growth.



Exceptional performance may lead to a full-time employment opportunity.



### Who We Are Looking For



We are looking for a systems-oriented professional who understands that automation is more than connecting triggers and actions. It is about creating an efficient, organized and scalable business environment.



The ideal candidate is someone who can recognize problems before they become major issues, bring solutions to the table and take ownership of assigned projects.



We value initiative, innovation, accountability, accuracy and measurable results.



### How to Apply



Interested candidates should submit:



1. An updated résumé.

2. A portfolio demonstrating GoHighLevel experience.

3. At least three examples of workflows they have personally developed.

4. An example of how their automation expertise improved a company's operations.

5. Desired hourly compensation and weekly availability.

6. A brief explanation of why they would be a valuable addition to our team.



**Applicants without demonstrable hands-on GoHighLevel automation experience will not be considered.**



If you are passionate about business automation, systems development and creating solutions that help businesses operate more efficiently, we want to hear from you!

We’re looking for an AI video artist to generate photorealistic, cinematic scenes for a premium mini-series in the manifestation space.

We're a multi-chain DeFi protocol building LP Bonds, a new liquidity primitive that locks liquidity long-term while keeping user positions tradable. We need Business Development partners who can introduce us to crypto launchpads, DEXs, chains, and established crypto projects.



We're live on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, ApeChain, BSC, Abstract, and Monad, with integrations running on Camelot DEX, HELLO DEX, and PancakeSwap. See it yourself: 



𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗢𝗣𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗧𝗬



Every successful introduction that leads to a partnership earns you serious money. One good partnership can be worth $5,000-10,000+ as it grows.



𝗖𝗢𝗠𝗣𝗘𝗡𝗦𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡



Base Pay: $10/hour, 10 hours/week ($100/week). Paid 50% in Ethereum (ETH) and 50% in $GMI tokens on an 18-month vesting schedule, building you a long-term position in the multi-chain $GMI ecosystem.



Minimum Requirement: 1 qualified appointment per week. A qualified appointment means a scheduled call that actually takes place between me and a decision-maker (founder, BD lead, or marketing head) at a crypto launchpad, DEX, chain, or established project, and meets our qualification criteria. Your first qualified appointment each week is covered by your base pay. All appointments and outreach are logged in our tracker; unlogged work doesn't count or pay.



Appointment Bonus: Every additional qualified appointment beyond the first pays $100, split 50% ETH and 50% $GMI (same vesting).



Commission: 20% of ALL upgrade fees generated by each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. Our 4-level upgrade system means every user your partnership brings in can pay upgrade fees multiple times, and you earn on every single one during your commission window.



Launch Bonus: 3% of the total dollar value of bonds minted through each of your partnerships during its first 180 days live. No ceiling.



Commission is paid bi-weekly as your 20% share of the $GMI collected in upgrade fees (fully liquid, no vesting), so your cut never depends on GMI price. Launch bonus is 3% of the USD value of bonds at time of mint, paid bi-weekly in ETH at the average ETH price over the 14 day payroll period.



Together with our referral program, we give nearly all of our upgrade revenue back to the people who grow the protocol. Every partnership you land gets its own fresh 180-day earning window.



𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗧𝗛𝗜𝗦 𝗟𝗢𝗢𝗞𝗦 𝗟𝗜𝗞𝗘 𝗜𝗡 𝗥𝗘𝗔𝗟 𝗠𝗢𝗡𝗘𝗬 (𝗼𝗻𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽):



Mints $50,000 in bonds: $1,500 launch bonus paid as it happens, plus 20% of every upgrade fee as they roll in

Mints $100,000 and generates $15,000 in upgrade fees: $3,000 + $3,000 = $6,000

Mints $200,000 and generates $30,000 in upgrade fees: $6,000 + $6,000 = $12,000



That's ONE introduction. Land three and run the math.



Note: A successful partnership means a project you introduced signs the LP Bonds integration agreement and goes live on our marketplace. You book the qualified call, I run the deal and close it.



𝗬𝗢𝗨 𝗛𝗔𝗩𝗘:



Existing connections in crypto (launchpads, DEXs, chains, established projects)

/
 relationships with project founders or marketing heads

Understanding of DeFi/crypto space

Hunger to earn based on results, not hours



𝗬𝗢𝗨 𝗗𝗢𝗡'𝗧 𝗡𝗘𝗘𝗗:



To close deals (I handle that)

Any upfront investment

Previous BD experience (connections matter more)



𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗘:



Your job is booking qualified calls. You reach into your network, find decision-makers at crypto projects, and get them on a scheduled call with me. I close the deals, you collect appointment bonuses, commissions, and launch bonuses as your partnerships go live and grow.



Ready to turn your crypto connections into serious income?



𝗔𝗣𝗣𝗟𝗬 𝗪𝗜𝗧𝗛:



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word BONDS

List 3-5 crypto projects/launchpads you have connections with

Your
 handle

Brief description of your crypto involvement

Tell me about a time you got someone onto a call after they ignored your first message



We need partners who see the opportunity and want to run with it.

title: Welcome to K-POP Universe: K-POP Content Creator & Video Editor (On-Camera Role)
description:
- Recruitment validity period: Until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement

- A PH VA team of more than 5 people has already been formed, and business collaboration is possible using Tagalog in a comfortable atmosphere.

- Providing educational tutorial videos and operating a mentorship program to help new comers quickly adapt



[About Us]

Company Introduction (Video):

youtu.be/dO2mWWZANx8



At Summitree, we are building a global K-POP e-commerce business with a multicultural team from Korea, the Philippines, Mongolia, and other countries.

Our Filipino team members are an important part of our global growth. By joining Summitree, you will become part of an international team working together to grow HiDuckoo into a global K-POP brand.



[Who We Are Looking For]

K-POP Content Creator & Video Editor (On-Camera Role)

We are not looking for a Video Editor who only edits footage provided by others.

We are looking for someone who genuinely loves K-POP and can take ownership of the entire content creation process:



**Trend Research → Idea Generation → Scriptwriting → B-roll Research → Shooting → Video Editing**



You will create both short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts and long-form content for YouTube.

Your goal is to create engaging content that attracts new audiences, grows the HiDuckoo brand, and ultimately contributes to sales.



[Responsibilities]

1. K-POP Content Planning

Follow current K-POP trends, including new artists, comebacks, fandom topics, memes, albums, merchandise, and social media trends, and turn them into engaging content ideas.

You should be able to independently research a topic, develop an idea, write a script, and plan the necessary B-roll.

2. HiDuckoo Behind-the-Scenes Content

Create interesting content from our actual e-commerce operations, including:

- Purchasing and receiving K-POP albums and merchandise

- New product arrivals

- Order processing

- Packing and shipping

- Warehouse and day-to-day operations

- HiDuckoo team behind-the-scenes

You should be able to turn ordinary business activities into content K-POP fans will enjoy watching.

3. Video Editing

Create and edit:

- Instagram Reels

- TikTok videos

- YouTube Shorts

- YouTube long-form videos

Use B-roll, subtitles, music, sound effects, transitions, hooks, storytelling, and pacing to create engaging videos that keep viewers watching.

4. On-Camera Content

For some content (refer to our 
 you will film yourself and appear on camera.

You do not need to appear in every video, but you must be comfortable speaking to viewers and having your face publicly featured on the company's social media channels.



[Required Qualifications]

- Strong video editing skills using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software

- Ability to edit both short-form and long-form content

- Strong interest in K-POP and active understanding of current trends

- Ability to independently research and plan content

- Ability to research and use appropriate B-roll

- Comfortable filming yourself and appearing on camera



[Preferred Qualifications]

- Experience creating K-POP or social media content

- Experience running a YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or K-POP fan account

- Understanding of hooks, retention, and storytelling

- Experience with Photoshop or Canva

- Experience in social media marketing or e-commerce

- Experience creating product or behind-the-scenes content

- Experience using AI tools such as Higgsfield, Seedance, ElevenLabs, Runway, CapCut AI, or similar tools in a content creation workflow



[Compensation & Benefits]

*Probationary Period: 6 Months

- Months 0–3: USD 250/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month, subject to satisfactory performance

The probationary period may be shortened for excellent performance.

*After Regularization:

- Base Salary: USD 300/month

- Guaranteed 13th Month Pay

- One-year contract renewal basis

- Performance-based incentives and salary increases

*Performance & Salary Growth

Content performance matters. Meaningful growth in social media followers and/or sales on the HiDuckoo online shopping mall will be considered for performance incentives and salary increases.

Outstanding results may lead to an earlier salary increase.

*Benefits

- 10 additional paid leave days after regularization

- One K-POP album from your favorite artist on your birthday after six months of employment

- Paid holidays on January 1st and Christmas Day

- Opportunity to work with an existing Filipino team of 5+ members

*Long Service Incentive

- 1 Year: PHP 17,000

- 3 Years: PHP 22,500

- 5 Years: PHP 28,000



[How to Apply]

Please complete our Google Form application:

If you run your own TikTok, Instagram, YouTube channel, or K-POP fan account, you are welcome to include it in your application.



Thank you.

title: Graphic Designer – Digital & Video (4-Month Contract)
description:
About Us



Mad Mex (Australia) is back to its OG roots! Fighting for Flavour, Defending for Freshness, and always bringing a Por El Sabor (for the flavour) attitude to everything we do.



We’re not here to play it safe or serve bland, boring “Mexican”. We’re here to bring big, bold, unapologetically Mexican flavours to Australia and build the most loved Mexican brand in the country while we do it.



With over 75 restaurants and growing fast, we’re entering our next phase of growth, investing in our brand, story, culture and familia, and bigger, bolder ways to bring Por El Sabor to life.



About the Role



This is a hands-on Graphic Designer role with a strong focus on digital, video, motion and photo editing. You’ll handle general graphic design across print and digital, and be our go-to person for video and motion content.



This is a contract role running from mid November 2026 to March 2027. There may be an opportunity to move into a full-time position after the contract, depending on business needs.



What you’ll do



- Create campaign ideas and finished design work across print and digital

- Edit and produce video, overlays and motion graphics for marketing and business communications

- Retouch food photography so it looks appetising and consistent, and support shoot planning

- Design for social, paid media, app, website, CRM, online ordering and in-restaurant screens

- Work with developers and channel owners so assets are correctly formatted and ready for launch

- Share print and production work with our Senior Graphic Designer



What you’ll need



- Proven graphic design experience across print and digital

- Professional video editing, compositing, motion graphics and photo editing experience. Basic template-based editing (e.g. Canva or CapCut templates only) won’t meet this requirement.

- Advanced Premiere Pro and After Effects skills, or equivalent professional tools

Colour correction and audio finishing skills

- Strong Illustrator, InDesign and Photoshop skills

- Excellent organisation, accuracy and communication, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines

- Strong written and spoken English

- A reliable computer and internet connection [confirm requirements]

- Food, hospitality, QSR or multi-site retail experience is a bonus



How to apply? Please send:



* Your CV

* A portfolio link (graphic design)

* A showreel link (video, motion and photo editing)



For each piece, tell us what you did and which software you used. Applications without a showreel won’t be considered.

description:
About Us



Mad Mex is back to its OG roots! Fighting for Flavour, Defending for Freshness, and always bringing a Por El Sabor (for the flavour) attitude to everything we do.



We’re not here to play it safe or serve bland, boring “Mexican”. We’re here to bring big, bold, unapologetically Mexican flavours to Australia and build the most loved Mexican brand in the country while we do it.



With over 75 restaurants and growing fast, we’re entering our next phase of growth, investing in our brand, story, culture and familia, and bigger, bolder ways to bring Por El Sabor to life.



About the Role



We’re looking for an Accountant to join us on a 6-month contract, with the potential to become permanent for the right person. You’ll own our Payroll and Bank Reconciliation processes and keep the numbers behind every restaurant accurate and on time. You’ll also back up the wider Finance team and help shape how we use AI and automation to work smarter.





What You’ll Be Doing



Payroll



- Own the end-to-end payroll process, from timesheet validation and pay runs through to releasing pay and lodging STP.

- Pay super and PAYG, and prepare, lodge and pay payroll tax in line with statutory and company deadlines.

- Deliver the weekly labour report on time and reconcile payroll balance sheet accounts.

- Manage the payroll inbox and respond to internal and ad hoc payroll queries.

- Liaise with our Workers Compensation insurer on annual lodgements and declarations across states and entities.

- Drive continuous improvement in payroll processes.



Bank & Revenue Reconciliations



- Complete daily bank reconciliations, investigating unmatched deposits and missing bankings with Business Managers.

- Reconcile petty cash weekly, confirm till floats by store monthly, and reconcile credit cards monthly back to the GL.

- Reconcile cash receipts, EFTPOS and Windcave online order receipts, and assist with delivery reconciliations when required.



Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Reporting



- Support AP, including booking invoices in NetSuite, validating the weekly AP export from TASK, reconciling supplier statements, and processing AP and rent payments.

- Support AR, including raising royalty, marketing fee and ad hoc invoices, processing direct debits and following up the AR ageing.

- Manage the shared Accounts inbox daily and support cash flow reporting.

- Own assigned period end tasks and monthly balance sheet reconciliations, and support audits with accurate, timely reports.

- Deliver ad hoc projects and special reports that give the business sharper insights.



AI, Automation & System Transformation



- Support our Finance AI automation project by documenting current processes and identifying manual pain points and automation opportunities.

- Act as a finance subject matter expert, translating accounting and compliance requirements into clear business rules for the project team and technology partners.

- Assist with solution design, UAT, data validation and parallel runs to make sure automated outputs are accurate and compliant.

- Help maintain controls, approvals, audit trails and exception handling in automated workflows.

- Support data quality and master data clean-up across NetSuite, payroll and related systems.

- Update procedures, prepare training materials and help the Finance team adopt new tools and processes.





What You Bring



- 3+ years’ accounting experience, including end-to-end payroll and bank reconciliations (hospitality preferred).

- Qualifications in accounting, business or commerce.

- Sound knowledge of Australian payroll requirements, including STP, superannuation, PAYG, payroll tax and workers compensation.

- Experience with ERP and payroll systems; Oracle NetSuite, Tanda and KeyPay preferred.

-Broad exposure across AP, AR, bank and revenue reconciliations, period end and balance sheet reconciliations.

-A strong interest in AI and automation within finance, with the ability to document processes and support testing and adoption of new tools. System transformation experience is preferred.

- Intermediate to advanced Excel skills (macros, XLOOKUPs); Power Query preferred.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills.

- Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong organisation and time management, with the ability to meet deadlines under pressure and work independently or in a team.

- A stable internet connection for remote work.

- Most importantly, you’re curious, adaptable and ready to Own It.



Why Mad Mex?



You’ll join a fast-growing Familia where Finance directly supports our restaurants, our people and our franchise partners.



There’s plenty of opportunity to learn, innovate, improve and grow into new areas of the department.



Bring your numbers game. Bring your curiosity for automation. Bring the Por El Sabor.





Please include a link to your CV and your monthly salary expectations with your application. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We can’t wait to see the spice you’ll bring to the table!

title: AI, 2D and 3D Video Editor
description:
## Job overview



We are looking for a genuinely high-level senior video editor and motion designer for a premium, cinematic mini-series in the personal-development space.



This is not standard social media editing. The series needs to feel like a high-end documentary meets a cinematic masterclass: visually bold, emotionally engaging, modern, and highly bingeable.



Depending on your skill set, your work may include AI scene generation, 2D and 3D animation,  building high-end motion graphics and kinetic typography, creating the visual effects to explain discussed concepts, designing transitions, or compositing/VFX. 



## What we’re looking for



- Experience in generating clones and re-creating entire scenes using AI

- Expert-level Adobe Premiere Pro skills: long-form editing, story pacing, colour/audio fundamentals, and excellent project organisation.

- Strong After Effects skills: motion graphics, kinetic typography, compositing, visual effects, and custom transitions.

- A portfolio showing cinematic long-form storytelling, premium branded content, documentaries, music videos, narrative YouTube, or similarly high-production work.

- Excellent taste in visual storytelling, pacing, music, sound design, typography, and contemporary design.

- Strong creative judgment: knowing when to use big visual moments and when to let an emotional moment breathe.

- Clear English communication, reliability, and the ability to take direction while bringing strong creative ideas to the table.



Big advantage: 3D, animation, or advanced VFX/compositing experience in Blender, Cinema 4D, Unreal Engine, DaVinci Resolve, or similar. This is not essential if you are exceptional in editing and motion design, but please tell us about it if it is part of your skill set.



## This role is not for you if



Your work relies mainly on repetitive templates, generic social-media edits, auto-captions, or random stock footage. We are not looking for generic visuals, cheesy effects, PowerPoint-style explainers, or fast cutting for the sake of fast cutting.



We want a premium, intentional visual world with editorial taste, strong rhythm, and original ideas.



## What we offer



- A creatively ambitious project with a clear visual direction and strong existing footage library.

- The chance to work on a flagship cinematic series rather than high-volume, templated content.

- Potential for continued full-time long-form YouTube editing work after the project for the right person.



## How to apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio or showreel, with your 2–3 most relevant examples first.

2. A short note explaining your specific role in each example (editor, motion designer, VFX/compositor, etc.).

3. Your rate expectations or preferred project-pricing structure.

4. Your availability, time zone, and expected AEST overlap.



Contact: Kal Dawson

title: Construction Estimator / Quantity Surveyor – Australian Construction Company
description:
Construction Estimator / Quantity Surveyor – Australian Construction Company (Remote)



Company: Clear Cut Construction Group Pty Ltd

Location: Remote – Philippines

Employment: Part-time / Full-time / Contract (Flexible)

Salary: Negotiable based on experience and capabilities



About Us:



Clear Cut Construction Group is an established Australian construction company based in Queensland, specialising in insurance repairs, residential maintenance, renovations and small commercial construction works.



We work with a number of insurance builders and contractors, carrying out a wide variety of construction and repair projects.



We are looking for an experienced Construction Estimator or Quantity Surveyor to assist with preparing detailed, accurate construction quotations.



This is an opportunity for someone with strong construction knowledge who can work independently, take ownership of the estimating process and potentially become a long-term member of our team.



About the Role:



We regularly receive purchase orders and scopes of work from insurance builders. Our director attends site, takes measurements, photographs and detailed voice notes identifying the work required.



Your responsibility will be to take this information and prepare comprehensive, fully costed construction quotations using our job management software, AroFlo.



We are looking for someone who can do more than simply follow an existing scope of works.



You must understand construction processes well enough to identify additional tasks, materials, labour and associated costs that may have been overlooked in the original scope.



The goal is to produce detailed quotations that are ready for our director to review, make any necessary adjustments and approve for submission.



Key Responsibilities:



Review purchase orders, scopes of work, site photographs, measurements and written or transcribed voice notes.



Prepare detailed construction quotations and material take-offs.



Break construction projects down into individual tasks and allocate appropriate labour and material costs.



Identify missing scope items and additional requirements necessary to complete the works.



Calculate material quantities and estimate realistic labour requirements.



Allow for associated expenses, including site establishment, access equipment, waste removal, cleaning, deliveries, travel and other relevant costs.



Obtain or verify material pricing from Australian suppliers when required.



Prepare and enter complete quotations into AroFlo using our established pricing structure and procedures.



Identify discrepancies or unclear information and raise questions where necessary.



Ensure quotations are thorough, accurate and commercially viable.



Types of Work:



Our projects typically involve:



Roofing repairs and roof replacements



Carpentry and structural timber repairs



Plasterboard and ceiling repairs



Internal and external painting



Flooring replacement



Water damage and storm damage repairs



Insurance reinstatement works



Residential renovations and general building maintenance



Small commercial construction and fit-out works



Projects range from relatively straightforward single-trade repairs through to more complex, multi-trade construction works.



Skills and Experience Required



Essential:



Previous experience in construction estimating or quantity surveying.



Strong understanding of residential construction methods, materials and labour requirements.



Ability to interpret scopes of work, construction drawings, site measurements and photographs.



Experience completing material take-offs and labour cost estimates.



Ability to identify missing construction activities and associated costs.



Excellent written English and communication skills.



Strong attention to detail and ability to work independently.



Competent computer skills and willingness to learn our estimating procedures.



Highly Desirable:



Previous estimating experience for Australian construction companies.



Experience with Australian residential renovations, insurance repairs or maintenance work.



Familiarity with Australian construction terminology, materials and building practices.



Experience with Australian supplier pricing.



Experience using AroFlo or similar construction estimating/job management software.



Previous AroFlo experience is not essential, as training can be provided. However, a strong understanding of construction estimating is important.



Employment Arrangements:



We are flexible regarding the initial working arrangement.



Ideally, we would like to begin with a paid trial involving several construction estimates to assess accuracy, construction knowledge and suitability.



If successful, there is an opportunity for ongoing full-time employment.



We would prefer to develop a long-term working relationship with someone who can become familiar with our business, pricing methods and estimating requirements.



How to Apply:



Please include the following information in your application:



Your construction qualifications and previous estimating experience.



Details of any work you have completed for Australian construction companies.



The types of construction projects and trades you have experience estimating.



The estimating software you have previously used.



Examples of previous construction estimates or material take-offs you have prepared, with confidential client information removed. (if available) 



Your expected hourly rate or monthly salary in AUD.



Your availability and preferred working arrangement.



Please note: We are specifically seeking someone with practical construction estimating experience. This is not a general virtual assistant or basic data-entry position.



We look forward to hearing from suitably qualified candidates.

title: Guest Experience VA for US Vacation Rentals (Airbnb / Vrbo / Hostaway), Morning Hours in PH
description:
ABOUT US

We run full-service, hands-off management for short-term rental owners across the US. Guests get a warm, fast, five-star stay. Owners get their homes run for them. We are a small, fast team that automates everything we can, and we need people who bring the judgment and follow-through software cannot.



THE SHIFT (GOOD NEWS: IT IS DAYTIME FOR YOU)



- 2:00 PM to 8:00 PM US Pacific, Wednesday through Sunday. Six hours a day, five days a week, about 30 hours a week.

- In Manila that is 6:00 AM to 12:00 noon, Thursday through Monday from early November to March, and 5:00 AM to 11:00 AM from March to early November.

- Your Tuesday and Wednesday (Manila) are off.

- Start date: flexible, within the next few weeks. You will train side by side with our team lead on this exact shift for your first two weeks, then run it on your own.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Answer guest messages across Airbnb, Vrbo and our direct site, all through Hostaway, in our warm and friendly StayAscend voice.

- Handle check-in and checkout questions, mid-stay issues, and early or late check-in requests.

- Resolve guest problems end to end, including small comps, discounts and refunds within clear limits. Anything above your limit goes up, never guessed.

- Keep turnovers on track: make sure every checkout has a confirmed cleaner and every home is guest-ready before the next arrival.

- Flag maintenance issues and follow up with vendors until they are fixed.

- Work the team bench in Slack: clean handoff notes at the end of every shift, and quick escalations when something needs a decision.

- Log what you do in Turnpoint, our operations app, so the next shift picks up where you left off.



MUST-HAVES



- 1+ year of guest support or operations for short-term or vacation rentals.

- Hands-on with Airbnb and Vrbo. Hostaway or another channel manager is a big plus.

- Warm, natural, native-level written English. Short and friendly, not stiff.

- Good judgment on what you can handle and what needs a human above you. We reward escalating over guessing.

- Honest. If you cannot confirm a fact, you say so. You never make one up.

- Stable power and internet with a real backup plan for outages.



NICE-TO-HAVES



- Experience coordinating cleaners and maintenance vendors.

- Comfortable in Slack and a task app.

- A story about calming down an upset guest and turning the stay around.



PAY AND TERMS



- $900 per month after a short paid trial, paid on the 1st and 15th by Wise.

- 13th month pay, flexible coordinated time off, and a merit review after your first 90 days.

- Paid trial first: a short, paid set of real guest and coordination tasks before any ongoing offer. We pay for your time on it.

- Independent contractor engagement.



Be honest with yourself before applying: this seat has a fast-response element during your shift (about 15 minutes, from your phone if needed). If you like to clock in, clock out and forget about it, this is not for you. If you want to own outcomes and grow with a company, it is a great fit.



HOW THIS WORKS



- You get your own scoped logins. You handle guest-side money within your limits, but you never touch owner money, payouts or financials. Those stay with the owner and the accounting team.

- We take guest privacy and platform rules seriously. You sign an NDA and a simple data-handling agreement before any access.



HOW TO APPLY



Read all the way through. Reply on OnlineJobs with the word MAHALO at the top so we know you did. Then answer this in 4 to 6 sentences:



A guest checks in at 7 PM Pacific and messages: "The house is not clean and the hot tub is cold. This is unacceptable." The cleaner is not answering. What do you do in the next 30 minutes, what do you tell the guest, and what do you escalate?



Also tell us your current schedule and whether 6:00 AM to noon Manila, Thursday through Monday, works for you week in and week out.



We read every answer. Generic or copy-pasted replies get skipped. Show us your judgment.

Please do not contact The Haus Keepers directly regarding this position. All applications must be submitted through the official application link below.



Anyone who contacts our company or team members directly by phone,
, text or social media regarding this position will automatically be disqualified for not following instructions.



About The Haus Keepers



The Haus Keepers is a growing cleaning company based in Colorado, USA.



We're looking for an experienced Vendor & Subcontractor Operations Manager to help us recruit, manage and build strong relationships with our independent cleaning business partners.



This is a hands-on management position. We're looking for someone who can independently solve problems, make sound decisions and take ownership without needing constant direction.



What You'll Do



**Vendor & Subcontractor Recruitment**

- Find, recruit and screen qualified independent cleaning businesses.

- Conduct interviews, verify references and review required documentation.

- Manage contractor onboarding and maintain a strong recruitment pipeline.

- Build relationships with reliable service providers as we grow.



**Contractor Operations & Accountability**

- Monitor contractor availability, reliability and accepted service commitments.

- Identify potential service issues before they affect clients.

- Address repeated problems and have difficult conversations when necessary.

- Hold contractor partners accountable to their agreements.

- Work closely with our Scheduling and Client Experience teams.



**Problem-Solving & Follow-Through**

- Investigate contractor-related complaints and gather relevant information.

- Coordinate insurance claims and outstanding documentation.

- Follow up on issues until they are fully resolved.

- Identify patterns, recommend improvements and prevent repeated problems.

- Keep accurate records and communicate important updates.



## Who We're Looking For



- At least 3 years of relevant experience in operations management, vendor management or subcontractor coordination.

- Experience recruiting and managing independent contractors or service providers.

- Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.

- Strong judgment and the ability to work independently.

- Confidence having difficult conversations and setting clear expectations.

- Excellent organization, follow-through and problem-solving skills.

- Experience using CRMs, tracking systems and project management tools.

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace and a backup connection.



Experience with U.S. home-service, property management, construction or maintenance businesses is a strong advantage.



What Matters Most



We want someone who takes ownership.



When a problem happens, you don't simply send a message and wait. You investigate, determine the next steps and make sure the issue gets resolved.



We value people who are proactive, dependable, respectful and confident enough to make difficult decisions.



## Position Details



**Company:** The Haus Keepers



**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Mountain Time



**Salary:** $1,800 USD/month 



**Employment:** Full-Time, Long-Term



How to Apply



Complete our official application here:







Our application includes questions about your experience, real-world scenarios and a short video introduction.



Only completed applications submitted through this link will be considered. Our hiring team will contact shortlisted candidates.



Please do not contact The Haus Keepers directly regarding this opening.

title: Appointment Setter (Medspa Niche) EST
description:
We are a fast-growing performance advertising startup based in Canada. We’re looking for a skilled Appointment Setter to join our team on a monthly long-term retainer, contingent on probation and ongoing performance. You will support our clients by calling and converting leads into booked appointments for our clients.



We want Setters who act as true consultants, not just script-readers. You will be handling leads for the health/beauty service industry (Medspas, Laser Clinics, Estheticians).



What You’ll Do:

-Call and qualify warm leads within 5 minutes of receiving them in our CRM.

-Manage and organize the CRM (scheduling, notes, and pipeline management).

-Follow up with potential patients via SMS and email to maximize booking rates.

-Handle objections professionally and educate leads on treatments (e.g., Botox, PRP, Laser Hair Removal, etc).

-Collaborate with our team to improve script and lead quality feedback.

-Attend daily/weekly check-in meetings



What We’re Looking For:

-Flawless English communication skills (Spoken & Written). You must sound confident, clear, and friendly on the phone with minimal/no accent.

-Experience in Sales or Appointment Setting.

-Prior experience working with Medspas or selling high-ticket beauty services.

-Tech Savvy: Familiarity with CRMs (GoHighLevel/GHL experience).

-Availability: Must work during Eastern Standard Time (EST) business hours.

-Focus: This will preferably be your main focus (no sub-contracts/agencies). You will work very closely with our team.

-Reliability: Fast response times via Slack/Email and a quiet working environment with reliable internet connection.



This is perfect for someone who:

-Thrives in a fast-paced, high-pressure startup environment.

-Is not afraid of the phone and can handle rejection with resilience.

-Is looking for a long-term growth opportunity with a diverse client base.





To apply, please send us:

-A short video introducing yourself and your previous experience related to this role.

-Scenario: How would you handle a lead who says, "That’s too expensive" for a laser treatment?

-Your availability (EST timezone)

-Salary/Commission expectations ($CAD).

-Resume/CV.



If selected for an interview, you may be asked to complete a mock-call assessment.
